jobs.title: Capital Program Manager
jobs.description:
Technical Capital Program Manager – Data Centre & Lab Facilities
LOCATION: Cessna Bangalore, India
AREA OF INTEREST: Construction Program Management
TECHNOLOGY INTEREST: Data Centres, Laboratories & Critical Facilities
About the Role
Workplace Resources (WPR) is seeking a Technical Capital Program Manager to lead the delivery of capital projects with a specific focus on data centre and laboratory environments across the APJC (Asia Pacific, Japan & China) region. This role combines the core discipline of capital program management - planning, budgeting, and delivering projects from inception through handover - with the technical depth required to manage complex, mission-critical facilities where uptime, resiliency, and compliance are paramount.
The ideal candidate will bring a strong construction/capital program management background together with hands-on exposure to data centre or lab build, fit-out, or upgrade projects, and will be comfortable engaging directly with M&E engineers, critical facilities teams, and specialist technical vendors.
The candidate should be based close to our Bangalore campus and have the ability to be on campus, participate in meetings in person and interact with vendors as needed.
Meet the Team
Workplace Resources (WPR) delivers workplace experiences to employees and optimizes company working capital at scale, with a focus on productivity and business outcomes. Within WPR, the Workplace Design & Construction Team comprises four pillars: Design, Change Management, Centralized Capital Program Management, and Commercial Management Offices. The team is responsible for the delivery of projects including data centre, lab, and critical facilities work, in addition to a broader transformational effort shaping how employees, partners, and customers interact with company spaces for decades to come.
Your Impact
As Technical Capital Program Manager, you will be accountable for planning, executing, and finalizing capital projects, including data centre and laboratory builds and upgrades, according to strict deadlines and within budget. This includes partnering with global procurement to acquire resources, coordinating the efforts of internal team members and third-party contractors or consultants, and acting as the single point of responsibility and escalation for the project life cycle from inception through design, business case development, delivery, and handover.
What You'll Do Day-to-Day
- Manage APJC capital program service partners to successfully plan, design, deliver, handover of capital projects assigned to you.

- Own the successful planning, brief development, and budgeting of a portfolio of capital projects, determined by the manager, with particular emphasis on technical and critical-infrastructure spaces.

- Act as the single point of responsibility and escalation for the project life cycle from inception through design, business case development, delivery, and handover.

- Effectively manage both upward communication to clients and stakeholders to ensure transparency and alignment, while providing clear, actionable direction and feedback to team members through consistent downward communication.

- Develop Project Execution Plans and manage Change Control for technical builds, including data centre and lab-specific commissioning and validation stages.

- Ensure projects comply with Construction Health & Safety Guidelines as well as data centre and laboratory-specific safety, security, and compliance standards.

- Develop a quarterly APJC Delivery Plan identifying requirements for capital projects, including due diligence, due diligence funding, and partner resourcing.

- Own due diligence for capital projects managed by service partners, ensuring cross-functional input (risk management, IT, critical facilities engineering, capital project management).

- Own compliance to global offerings guidelines and standards, including relevant data centre design and operational standards.

- Solve complex problems and identify viable, innovative options, using analytical skills and judgment to recommend an appropriate solution, particularly where technical, operational, and construction constraints intersect.

- Translate strategy into clear operating plans that promote operational excellence in service delivery with measurable results.

- Leverage program management expertise, together with technical facilities knowledge, to identify areas of risk or concern in complex, mission-critical builds.

Key Responsibilities
- Capital Project Planning: Using agreed business requirements from WPR partners, develop comprehensive project plans, including for data centre and lab environments, that align with the strategic objectives of the organization.

- Technical & Critical Facilities Delivery: Partner with project teams, M&E engineers, critical facilities operations, and specialist vendors to deliver data centre and laboratory capital projects, covering power, cooling, redundancy, and life-safety systems.

- Portfolio Management: Oversee the performance of multiple projects, ensuring they remain on track in terms of scope, schedule, and budget.

- Budget Management: Partner with the Commercial Management Office to oversee budget development and financial project controls; partner with business managers on budget submissions to the Capital Finance Review Board.

- Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a primary point of contact for stakeholder engagement across the APJC Theatre for assigned programme, providing updates on project performance and addressing concerns.

- Team Coordination: Lead, coach, and motivate project team members and project managers leading and executing projects in your portfolio, influencing them to take positive action and accountability for their assigned work.

- Risk Management: Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path, assess risks, including those specific to live or occupied technical environments and develop mitigation strategies.

- Reporting: Track project milestones and deliverables and prepare status reports for senior management.

- Performance Monitoring: Track and report on project metrics and performance indicators to senior management.

- Process Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve project management processes and methodologies, including those specific to data centre and lab delivery, to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience
- Deep understanding of the processes, procedures, and systems used in Capital Program Management and Service Delivery Management, and recognition of downstream impact on other disciplines.

- Working technical knowledge of data centre and/or laboratory environments, including power and cooling infrastructure, redundancy/resiliency concepts, and commissioning processes.

- Proficient with technology, tools, and processes that support service delivery; plays a part in promoting and developing improvements to functional tools and processes.

- Deep knowledge of project/program management methodologies and an understanding of real estate and critical facilities industry practices, evolution, and application to service delivery processes.

- Ability to analyse multiple sources of complex information and evaluate several alternative solutions before recommending a path forward.

- Ability to explain complex technical information and effectively lay out the pros and cons of alternatives for non-technical stakeholders to consider.

- Strongly developed ability to communicate and drive improvement across cross-functional teams to improve operations metrics and customer satisfaction; strong service level management and operations management skills.

- Deep understanding of key Capital Program Management concepts with the ability to explain these effectively to management or cross-functional teams and provide training.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

- Extensive experience in project and program management (8+ years minimum), with a strong focus on construction capital program management and program delivery for construction projects.

- Demonstrable experience delivering data centre, laboratory, or other mission-critical/technical facility projects, from design through commissioning and handover.

- Expertise in managing diverse teams of vendors, M&E engineers, and contractors across multiple projects.

- Demonstrates proficiency in concise reporting and clear communication when providing updates to senior leadership.

- Proficiency in project management software tools.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent communication and leadership skills.

- Knowledge of local regulations and industry standards relevant to data centre and laboratory construction across APJC markets, specifically Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Bangalore, India.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Experience managing projects in sectors such as data centres, laboratories, critical infrastructure, or IT/technology fit-out.

- Certification in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is a plus.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Disclaimer
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
- be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
- begin with screening or an interview
- originate from a Cisco email address, and
- be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com , do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

jobs.title: Strategy & Planning Manager
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/05/2026 Meet the Team
Our Corporate Strategy & Planning team serves as an internal strategy consulting function, helping Cisco leaders evaluate complex business and strategic questions and translate analysis into actionable recommendations. The team works across the organization on priorities that may include AI and emerging technologies, market and competitive strategy, business and investment decisions, long-term growth, M&A and ecosystem opportunities, and business transformation. This is an opportunity to work on high-impact, enterprise-level questions, rapidly develop expertise across new topics, and influence strategic decisions across Cisco.

Your Impact
Operating in a matrix environment, you will work across a range of strategic projects and partner with leaders across Corporate Strategy, Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Go-to-Market, Corporate Development, and other organizations. Lead strategic workstreams from problem definition through research, analysis, and development of recommendations for senior leadership. Structure ambiguous business questions, evaluate internal and external data, develop business cases and strategic frameworks, and assess scenarios, trade-offs, and potential investments to support informed decision-making. Apply analytical and technology fluency to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and develop clear, defensible recommendations that inform enterprise-level business decisions.

Minimum Qualifications

You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.

- Strategic Cost Management & Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.

- Product Quality & Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
- Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
- EOL Strategy & Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
- Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.
- Field Performance & Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins.

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
- 10+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
- Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management.
- Deep expertise in supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
- Advanced knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

- Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA
- Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.

- Extensive experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.

Every line of code Cisco ships carries a promise of trust. - Skilled at influencing without direct authority: a trusted team player who builds alignment across teams and partners and rallies others toward a shared goal.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
Join Cisco Capital APJC , a high-growth, high-impact organization focused on accelerating business bookings and enabling growth across the region. The Finance team serves as a strategic partner to Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders , helping enable bookings while balancing financial performance, risk, and business objectives.
Your Impact
As a Finance Leader supporting Cisco Capital APJC , you will play a critical role in driving regional business performance, growth, and financial outcomes. Supporting $1B+ in annual bookings and a sales organization of more than 30 sellers, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, using financial expertise, modeling, and business insights to influence strategic decisions.
You will lead and develop a team of three finance professionals while partnering across Sales, Finance, Credit, Operations, and Compliance to structure commercial opportunities, optimize profitability, and support sustainable business growth.

jobs.description:

Join the Cisco Silicon One team in accelerating the delivery of next-generation networking products through robust, scalable, and high-performance development infrastructure. Our organization serves as the backbone for silicon development, validation, and product execution, providing the essential compute, hardware, and lab ecosystems required for industry-leading innovation.

We are seeking a high-driven, results-oriented multidisciplinary orchestrator to act as the primary catalyst for our development infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the critical intersection of product strategy, hardware engineering, and lab operations, serving as the connective tissue that aligns disparate teams under a unified goal. You will be responsible for driving cross-functional alignment across the organization, effectively managing stakeholders with differing ownership to ensure infrastructure roadmaps scale alongside product milestones. Your Impact
You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of infrastructure projects, ensuring that our Sanity Test Beds and development environments are optimized to meet aggressive product launch timelines. Join Cisco's Silicon Operations Team and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of networking as the NPI Product Supply Chain Program Manager (SCPM) for our innovative Cisco Silicon One™ products. This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of next-generation network technology, working within a dynamic and customer-focused supply chain organization.
As a key member of the Silicon Manufacturing Operations (SMO) team, you will be the end-to-end owner for a product family, ensuring seamless supply chain execution from customer demand to product delivery.

Your Impact
- Production Readiness:  Usher our new products from concept to production release by ensuring core operational checklists are completed supporting manufacturability at high volume.
- Demand & Supply Alignment:  Translate customer demand for prototypes, pilots and production ramp into actionable resource requirements, including raw materials, capacity enablement, and manufacturing schedules.
- Order Management:  Manage supply allocation and sales orders, including assigning Schedule Ship Dates (SSD) for new orders and revisions.
- Managing Planning Parameters:  Proactively analyze and manage system lead times and yields, communicating updates weekly to ensure customer requirements are met.
- Internal Customer Management:  Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, providing timely responses (within 24 hours). Understand customer demand and translate to resource requirements (raw materials, loading plan, capacity need, etc)
- Materials Management:  Oversee the procurement of materials and purchase order (PO) timing against schedules.
- Manufacturing Execution:  Issue assembly build instructions in collaboration with Assembly Engineering (ASY ENG), manage assembly loading schedules and priorities, and manage testing instructions and schedules with Test Engineering.
- Fulfillment Oversight:  Create weekly assembly loading plans based on committed ship plans, and proactively monitor fulfillment to ensure on-time delivery.
- Inventory Management:  Develop and maintain a rolling 6-month ship plan.

Required Qualifications

- 6+ years in supply planning or supply chain management within the semiconductor industry.
- Experience working with semiconductor manufacturing processes and supply chain principles.
- Experience working with BOM structures, manufacturing routing processes (including alternative routes and materials), and product configurations.
- Experience with ERP systems and advanced planning tools.

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field - or equivalent education and experience.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, specifically working with dynamic scenario planning

jobs.description:

We are Cisco's Failure Analysis & Prevention team, which plays a critical role in ensuring high Customer/Product quality. The Technology and Quality organization is responsible for delivering customer-focused quality, reliability solutions and infrastructure for Cisco products. This position leads a team of Engineers in one or several of the following fields: Fault Isolation, Test/Software Development, Electrical, Mechanical and Manufacturing, to drive product quality in the factory. - Manage lab operations, equipment maintenance, and field service/depot repair processes
- Ensure the EMS Partners sites have the outstanding Quality Management System (QMS) deployed throughout their operation
- Lead operational excellence metrics ACT Yield, timely Delivery, etc. and accountable for associated business results
- Accountable to solve any factory related quality issues involving failure analysis and its processes
- Drive cycle time reduction, test optimizations, and quality improvement to meet and improve cost and lead time
- Partners with various cross-functional organizations including Product Operations, Supplier Management, Planning, Fulfillment, Technology and Quality to drive business outcomes as applicable
- Drive qualification of SMT lines for next gen PCBA technologies, BGA, edge bonding, large press fit connectors, and process characterizations.
- Builds strong organization with leadership bench strength, capabilities for the future, engagement
- Focus on Supply Chain innovation through process, tools and test reengineering and implementation
- Act as the escalation point for critical issues, reporting risk assessments and ETA metrics to senior leadership

- 10+ years of broad Supply Chain Electronics Technical Operations experience in Failure Analysis, Test Development Engineering or Manufacturing Process experience. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering or a related field required

- Strong knowledge and experience in Failure Analysis, Functional Test and/or PCBA SMT operations and factory management. Develop solutions to complex problems and implement short / long term technical strategies
- Familiarity with complex electro-mechanical systems, bench testing, fault isolation equipment, and debugging methodologies
- Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI), RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) tracking, and supply chain alignment
- Extensive Project Management knowledge with ability to influence to all levels and build trust to achieve a shared vision and drive accountability

jobs.title: Commercial Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
This role is part of Cisco’s broader Finance organization and reports to the India & Sub-continent Commercial Finance Leader . As a Commercial Finance Manager, you will be an integral part of the sales organization, working closely with Area VPs, Sales Directors, Finance Controllers, and cross-functional stakeholders to support complex business transactions across the Asia-Pacific region.
You will serve as a strong business partner and trusted advisor to Sales , providing financial and commercial guidance throughout the lifecycle of non-standard deals while ensuring alignment with Cisco’s policies, governance, and risk requirements.
Your Impact
As a Commercial Finance Manager , you will lead and coordinate the structuring, review, and approval of complex and non-standard business opportunities. You will apply strong commercial judgment to help Cisco optimize margins, manage risk, and remain competitive.
You will work closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to structure commercially viable deals, assess financial impacts, identify risks, and ensure appropriate approvals and governance. Your role will provide exposure across multiple areas of the business and will be critical to enabling successful and compliant customer transactions.
What You’ll Do
You will manage and support the end-to-end deal structuring, review, and approval process for non-standard deals within your assigned accounts or geography. You will partner with Sales teams to optimize deal structures, mitigate financial and commercial risks, and address potential channel, country, or theatre conflicts.
You will facilitate deal reviews and approvals by coordinating communication between Sales, Finance, and other relevant stakeholders. You will provide guidance on pricing, deal packaging, and non-standard deal policies , while helping Sales teams understand and comply with established processes.
You will perform scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, what-if comparisons, NPV, and IRR analysis to support deal structuring and commercial decision-making.
You will ensure appropriate deal governance, compliance, and risk assessment throughout the transaction lifecycle. You will also identify potential revenue recognition considerations and partner with the Corporate Revenue Accounting team on non-standard terms and revenue-related issues.
You will collaborate with Legal on contract reviews and assessments and build strong cross-functional relationships with Sales Account Teams, Legal, Segment Finance, Sales & Services Finance, Treasury, Cisco Capital, Tax, Corporate Revenue, and other business functions.
You will maintain a strong understanding of Cisco’s products, services, and new offerings to provide effective commercial guidance and support evolving business requirements.
Who You’ll Work With
You will work closely with Sales Account Teams, Area VPs, Sales Directors, Finance Controllers, Segment Finance, Sales & Services Finance, Legal, Treasury, Cisco Capital, Tax, Corporate Revenue Accounting , and other internal and external stakeholders involved in business transactions.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics , or a related field, with an MBA preferred .
Minimum 8 years of experience in commercial finance, pricing, deal management, bid management, or a related business finance function.
Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with experience evaluating commercial opportunities and supporting complex business decisions.
Strong communication, interpersonal, stakeholder-management, planning, and time-management skills, with the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and business pressure.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous experience as a business partner within the IT, Technology, or Telecommunications industry is preferred.
Experience in deal management, commercial finance, pricing, RFPs, bids, tendering, or complex deal structuring is highly desirable.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel , including Pivot Tables, data manipulation, financial analysis, scenario modelling, and sensitivity analysis.
Experience leveraging AI and automation to improve deal management, analysis, and execution efficiency.
Understanding of revenue recognition, contract terms, risk assessment, and financial governance is advantageous.
Knowledge of Cisco’s product and service portfolio is preferred but not essential.

Meet the Team
You will be part of the Distributed Systems Engineering (DSE) Engineering Operations PMO Team that is responsible for managing software projects for the Cisco routing, optical and automation portfolio. We are looking for a seasoned Program Manager to contribute to the delivery of innovative software solutions within our fast-paced CNE group. Managing cross-functional programs and delivering ground breaking SW for Cisco Networking Engineering (CNE). Manage software programs, complex solutions and releases in close collaboration with cross-functional teams spanning geographic regions, product areas and functions.
- As a Technical/Engineering Program Manager you would be described as a driven and results oriented leader. Self-starter; willing to roll-up your sleeves to get things done.
- Master of orchestration, able to balance various priorities at the same time.
- You have a keen ability to work with a broad range of cross-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Vendors, Customer Experience, Technical Support, Documentation and frequently with peers within PMO teams.

jobs.title: Sales Business Development Manager (Automotive)
jobs.description:
職務概要
短期および長期的な営業機会を特定し、専門家（SME）として需要喚起、事業開発、提案策定を牽引します。質の高い案件パイプラインを構築し、新規顧客との関係を深め、アップセル機会を見出し、アカウントチームと連携して複雑な案件を成約へと導きます。 テクノロジー、ソリューション、業界に基づいたサービスや新しい消費モデルを開発し、顧客のニーズとシスコのビジネス目標を合致させます。フィールド部門、ビジネスユニット、製品、サービス、マーケティング、パートナーと密接に連携し、シスコの市場での立ち位置を強化し、シェア拡大を図ります。 本職務は自動車業界に戦略的な重点を置いており、自動車バリューチェーン全体および車両ライフサイクルにおいてシスコの価値提案を最大化することを目的としています。主要領域は、コネクテッドカー、ソフトウェア定義車両（SDV）、スマートシティ＆モビリティ、製造、コネクテッドサービスであり、従来のエンタープライズITの枠を超えてシスコの影響力を拡大します。

専門領域と焦点
- 需要喚起 / 事業開発
- 案件形成および資格認定（Opportunity Qualification）
- ソリューション販売および新しい消費モデルの導入
- クロスアーキテクチャおよび業界別価値提案の策定
- 顧客・市場フィードバックを通じた製品改良
- 自動車業界の事業開発

顧客エンゲージメントと責任
- 顧客親密度: 高
- 顧客への焦点: 垂直市場/業界、ソリューション販売、新規事業開発
- 製品への焦点: 中程度（アーキテクチャ、ソリューション、ビジネス変革に重点）
- 新規・既存顧客および主要な意思決定者との関係構築・深化。
- ステークホルダーの特定、顧客優先事項の把握、アップセル機会の特定、シスコのシェア拡大領域の発見。
- 複雑な顧客ニーズに対応し、新規案件を創出するためのディスカバリーセッションおよびワークショップの主導。
- 従来のIT組織を超えた、エンジニアリング、R&D、製造、車両ソフトウェア、コネクテッドサービス、モビリティ、ビジネス戦略部門への働きかけ。

事業開発および案件形成
- 複数の製品、ソリューション、地域にわたる短期・長期の案件を積極的に特定し、資格認定を行う。
- ターゲットを絞った見込み顧客開拓と市場調査を行い、顧客ニーズ、業界トレンド、競争優位性を発見する。
- 質の高いパイプラインを構築し、適切なアカウントチームを巻き込んで実行・成約を図る。
- 技術的、商業的、および顧客の要件を整合させ、複雑で多製品にわたる案件を形成する。
- シスコのビジネス目標と整合させつつ、顧客のタイムラインと目標を満たす取引構造を策定する。
- アカウントチーム、ビジネスユニット、製品、サービス、エンジニアリング、マーケティング、法務、財務、パートナーなど、部門横断的なチームを統括する。
- CRMおよび予測プロセスを最適化し、パイプラインの質と正確性を向上させる。

自動車業界への注力領域 自動車業界全体で新規ビジネス機会を創出し、車両ライフサイクルとバリューチェーン全体でシスコの有用性を最大化する。
- コネクテッドカー: セキュアな車両コネクティビティ、データ交換、クラウド/エッジ統合、V2I（車両対インフラ）接続、コネクテッド車両エコシステム。
- ソフトウェア定義車両 (SDV): 車両、エッジ、クラウド、ネットワーク、セキュリティ、可観測性、データ、AIアーキテクチャ全体におけるシスコの価値提案の策定。
- スマートシティ＆モビリティ: 車両や自動車顧客とスマートシティ、インテリジェント交通システム、モビリティサービス、コネクテッドインフラを繋ぐ機会の創出。
- 製造: スマートマニュファクチャリング、産業用ネットワーク、セキュリティ、エッジコンピューティング、AI、製造業の変革における機会の特定。
- 車両ライフサイクル: R&D、設計、エンジニアリング、製造から販売、車両運用、コネクテッドサービス、アフターサービス、廃車に至るまでの機会特定。
- 自動車バリューチェーン: OEM、サプライヤー、製造オペレーション、ディーラー、モビリティプロバイダー、テクノロジーパートナーなど、エコシステム参加者全体への影響力拡大。
- 新規ビジネス＆消費モデル: 顧客の導入を加速し、拡張性のある収益機会を生み出す新しいユースケースや商習慣、消費モデルの開発。

社内・企業間連携 主要な連携先：アカウントチーム、ビジネスユニット、製品/サービススペシャリスト、製品開発、エンジニアリング、マーケティング、パートナー、法務、財務。 部門横断的な統合型アーキテクチャを提供し、顧客の新たな要件を拡張性の高いソリューションやビジネス機会へと変換する。

一般的な販売サイクル
- 案件規模: 売上高 500万ドル超
- 案件の複雑性: 高い複雑性とカスタマイズ性
- 販売サイクル: 平均12～18ヶ月（最大2年）
- 営業プロセス: 見込み顧客開拓 / 資格認定 / 案件形成

成功指標
- 収益成長: 新規および既存の製品・ソリューション全体での売上増加。
- 需要喚起: 新規顧客需要の創出、競合からのリプレイス、シスコのシェア拡大。
- パイプラインの量と質: 資格認定されたパイプラインの件数、価値、質の向上。
- 新規市場の創出: コネクテッドカー、SDV、スマートシティ＆モビリティ、製造、コネクテッドサービスでの増分機会の開発。
- 価値提案の拡大: 自動車バリューチェーンおよび車両ライフサイクル全体における、シスコのアドレス可能な市場と優位性の拡大。

最小資格要件
- 学士号取得者 ＋ 関連業務経験7年以上、または
- 修士号取得者 ＋ 関連業務経験4年以上、または
- 博士号取得者 ＋ 関連業務経験1年以上

歓迎される資格
自動車業界、コネクテッドカー、ソフトウェア定義車両（SDV）、スマートモビリティ、スマートシティ、自動車製造、または関連技術エコシステムにおける経験や専門知識を優先する。

Role Summary
Identifies short- and long-term sales opportunities and acts as an SME to drive demand generation, business development, and proposal development. Builds a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities, cultivates new customer relationships, identifies upsell opportunities, and partners with account teams to shape and close complex deals.
Develops technology-, solution-, and industry-based offerings and new consumption models that align customer needs with Cisco’s business objectives. Works closely with Field, Business Units, Product, Services, Marketing, and Partners to strengthen Cisco’s market position and expand wallet share.

Key domains include Connected Car, Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV), Smart City & Mobility, Manufacturing, and Connected Services , extending Cisco’s relevance beyond traditional enterprise IT.

Specialization and Focus

- Cross-Architecture and Industry Value Proposition Development
- Product Enhancement through customer and market feedback
- Automotive Industry Business Development

Customer Engagement and Accountability

Automotive Industry Focus
Develop new business opportunities across the Automotive industry and maximize Cisco’s relevance throughout the vehicle lifecycle and automotive value chain .
Key areas include:
- Connected Car – Secure vehicle connectivity, data exchange, cloud/edge integration, vehicle-to-infrastructure connectivity, and connected vehicle ecosystems.
- Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) – Develop Cisco’s value proposition across vehicle, edge, cloud, networking, security, observability, data, and AI architectures.
- Smart City & Mobility – Develop opportunities connecting vehicles and Automotive customers with smart cities, intelligent transportation, mobility services, and connected infrastructure.

- Vehicle Lifecycle – Identify Cisco opportunities from R&D, design and engineering, and manufacturing through sales, vehicle operation, connected services, after-sales, and end-of-life.

- New Business & Consumption Models – Develop new use cases, commercial approaches, and consumption models that accelerate customer adoption and create scalable revenue opportunities.

Act as an Automotive industry SME, connecting customer strategy and emerging industry requirements with Cisco capabilities. Provide structured market and customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to influence future solutions and product enhancements.

Internal & Corporate Interlock
Key Working Partners: Account Teams, Business Units, Product/Service Specialists, Product Development, Engineering, Marketing, Partners, Legal, and Finance.
Work across Cisco organizations to create integrated, cross-architectural offerings and convert emerging customer requirements into scalable solutions and business opportunities.

Typical Sales Cycle

Success Measures

- Pipeline Volume & Value – Increase the volume, value, and quality of qualified pipeline.

About Cisco: At Cisco, we know that technology can connect us, empower us, and drive us. By simplifying powerful technology, we can free hardworking people to focus on their mission. As the fastest growing cloud-managed networking team in the world, our products and technology architecture are changing the face of enterprise networking and making cloud-managed IT a reality.

By leveraging your expertise in customer engagement, analytics, and technical acumen, you will empower customers to unlock the full potential of the Meraki platform while driving long-term adoption and loyalty. Professional level (e.g., CCNP) or equivalent relevant certification expected. Business Intelligence/analytics experience is a plus.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist - CAI
jobs.description:
チーム紹介
CiscoのCustomer Experience（CX）組織は、社内で最も成長の速いチームの一つです。目的は明確で、 お客様がCiscoへの投資から、確実で長く続く価値を得られるようにすること です。

私たちは「技術」と「ビジネス」の両方が交わる場所で働いています。お客様と一緒に、日々の運用の改善や、お客様自身が重視する成果の達成を目指します。

Customer Success Specialist（CSS）チームは、深い製品知識と「お客様の成功を本気で知りたい」という好奇心を持つ技術アドバイザーの集まりです。外から見守るのではなく、 お客様の隣に立って伴走します。

活動領域は次の3つで、世界中のメンバーとアダプションの手法や学びを共有しています。
- ネットワーキング
- セキュリティ
- クラウド＆AIインフラ

難易度の高い技術課題に向き合うことが好きな方、製品の改善に自分の意見を反映させたい方、知的で好奇心のある同僚と働きたい方に向いているチームです。

この仕事で生み出せるインパクト
あなたは 戦略アドバイザー兼テクニカルエキスパート として、製品の活用を加速し、目に見えるビジネス価値を生み出す取り組みをリードします。
担当するのは アダプションジャーニー全体 です。

- お客様環境の現状把握（ベースライン設定）
- オンボーディング（立ち上げ）
- ロードマップの作成 経営層向けワークショップの実施
- Ciscoの製品ロードマップに直接活かされるフィードバックの提供

このポジションのゴールは、お客様が「製品を買った」段階から「価値を実際に引き出している」段階へ進むことです。その全ステップで信頼されるガイドになります。

影響範囲は個々の案件にとどまりません。 「顧客の声」の代表 として、製品ポートフォリオ全体の課題や機会をCiscoのエンジニアリング部門・製品管理部門に届けます。

主な業務内容
- ワークショップやセッションの主導 影響力の大きいワークショップ、Expert-Insight-Series（EIS）、Acceleratorsを、お客様の状況に合わせて実施します。基礎的な製品理解から高度な機能の活用まで幅広く対応し、内容の改善に向けてCX製品管理チームへ積極的に提言します。

- 価値実現までの期間短縮 実証済みの アダプションフレームワーク を活用し、「購入」から「望むビジネス成果の実現」までのギャップを埋めます。環境のベースライン設定や、包括的なオンボーディング計画の策定を担います。

- アダプションリスクの早期発見と解消 利用率が伸びない、他システムと連携できないといった 活用が進まないリスク を特定します。お客様の期待値を適切に調整し、課題を素早く解決します。

- 計画とコミュニケーションの文書化 アダプション計画 、サイトマトリックス、部門横断の連絡事項を文書化し、詳細なロードマップとして整備します。関係者全員が各段階で同じ認識を持てる状態を保ちます。

- 意思決定と設計のガイド 戦略・戦術の両面でお客様の判断を支援します。アーキテクチャ検討をリードし、Cisco検証済み設計（CVD）を取り入れることで、長期的な製品活用を実現します。

応募要件（MUST）
※すべてではなく、以下のうち 2〜3項目 を満たしていることが目安です。（日本語は必須）

言語 流暢な日本語（必須）
データセンター製品の専門性 ACI、HyperFlex、UCS、Nexus、MDS、Intersight、Nutanix、NDFC、NDI のエキスパートレベルの知識
ハイブリッドクラウドの理解 パブリッククラウド（AWS、Azure、GCP）および仮想化技術に関する深い理解
オーケストレーション APIやプログラマビリティを活用し、Ciscoソリューションをお客様の既存環境に統合できるスキル
経験年数 技術コンサルティング、またはクラウド＆AIインフラ領域（CAI）の顧客対応業務で7〜10年以上
学歴 工学またはコンピュータサイエンスの学士号（修士号があれば望ましい）
資格 CCIEがあれば望ましく、Cisco Certified Success Specialist認定も推奨
アダプション支援の実務経験 Ciscoのデータセンターソリューション（ACI、HyperFlex、UCS、Nexus、MDS、Intersight、NDFC/NDI）とパブリッククラウド（AWS、Azure、GCP）の連携に関する理解があり、APIやプログラマビリティを用いてお客様の既存環境に組み込んだ経験

歓迎要件（WANT）
- 工学・コンピュータサイエンスまたは関連分野の修士号、もしくは同等の実務経験

- 複数の上級資格（CCIE、CISM、CISSP）。 Cisco Certified Success Specialist 認定があれば特に歓迎

- 社外への情報発信の経験（フレームワークの公開、外部登壇、記事執筆など）

- シニア技術者の育成や、チーム全体のスキル向上への貢献経験

- ネットワーキング／セキュリティ／クラウド＆AIインフラなど複数領域の経験があり、お客様との会話で領域横断の知見を活かせること

なぜCiscoなのか
#WeAreCisco — 一人ひとりが違うからこそ、チームとして力を合わせたときに大きな成果が生まれます。
創業36年で「ハードウェアの会社」と思われがちですが、私たちはソフトウェア企業でもあり、セキュリティ企業でもあります。自ら学び、予測し、適応し、守る「インテュイティブ・ネットワーク」を生み出したのも私たちです。ひとつの枠には収まりません。
ただし「デジタルトランスフォーメーション」は、挑戦と創造、そして 失敗から学ぶことを許す文化 がなければ、ただの言葉です。だから私たちは日々、「与えること」を大切にしています。全力を出す。プライドは一旦置く。自分自身を差し出す（社会への還元はCiscoのDNAです）。責任を持ち、大胆に踏み出し、違いを本気で尊重する。多様な考え方と平等への姿勢がなければ、前に進めないからです。
髪の色が派手でも気にしません。タトゥーもどうぞ。水玉が好き？いいですね。ポップカルチャー好き？仲間はたくさんいます。 テクノロジーと世界を変えることに情熱があるなら、そのままのあなたで来てください。

※こちらは本ポジションの概要を表した日本語版です。さらなる詳細は以下の英語版をご覧ください。

Meet the Team
The Cisco Customer Experience (CX) organisation is one of Cisco’s fastest-growing teams, with a clear purpose: helping customers get real, lasting value from their Cisco investments. We work at the crossroads of technical knowledge and business understanding, partnering with customers to improve how they operate and achieve outcomes that matter to them. The Customer Success Specialist (CSS) team is a collaborative group of technical advisors who bring deep product knowledge and a genuine curiosity about customer success; We work side-by-side with customers to guide them, not from the sidelines. We are part of a global community that shares adoption approaches and learning across three areas of focus: Networking, Security, and Cloud & AI Infrastructure. If you enjoy working through sophisticated technical challenges, contributing to how Cisco’s products improve over time, and collaborating with curious, knowledgeable colleagues, this team is a great fit.

Your Impact
As a Customer Success Specialist, you will serve as a strategic advisor and technical expert, leading targeted engagements that accelerate product adoption and drive measurable business value for Cisco’s customers. You will lead the full adoption journey, from baselining customer environments and building onboarding roadmaps to facilitating executive-level workshops and providing feedback that directly crafts Cisco’s product roadmap. Success in this role means customers move from purchasing a solution to actively realizing its value, with you as the trusted guide at every step. Your influence extends well beyond individual engagements: as the “voice of the customer,” your insights will advise Cisco Engineering and Product Management on challenges and opportunities across the product portfolio.

- Lead high-impact workshops, Expert-Insight-Series (EIS) sessions, and Accelerators tailored to diverse customer needs, from foundational product awareness to sophisticated feature adoption, while proactively providing feedback to CX Product Management to improve these offerings.
- Accelerate value realization by applying validated adoption frameworks to help customers bridge the gap between purchasing a Cisco solution and achieving their desired business outcomes, including baselining environments and developing comprehensive onboarding journeys.
- Identify and mitigate adoption risks, such as low technical usage or integration barriers, by handling customer expectations and resolving issues promptly to ensure a successful customer journey.
- Document adoption plans, site matrices, and multi-functional communications to build detailed roadmaps, ensuring all project collaborators remain aligned at every stage of the onboarding lifecycle.
- Guide customers on strategic and tactical decisions, lead architectural initiatives, and incorporate Cisco validated designs to ensure successful, long-term product utilization.

Minimum Qualifications
- Fluent Japanese proficiency
- Stack Mastery:   Expert knowledge of ACI, HyperFlex, UCS, Nexus, MDS, Intersight, Nutanix, NDFC, and NDI.
- Hybrid Cloud:   Expert understanding of public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and virtualisation technologies.
- Orchestration:   Proficiency in using APIs and programmability to integrate Cisco solutions into existing customer ecosystems.

- Experience:   7–10+ years in technical consulting or CAI-focused customer-facing roles.
- Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science; Master’s preferred.
- Certifications:   CCIE preferred; Cisco Certified Success Specialist suggested.
- Demonstrate expert-level knowledge in the specialized technical tracks, focusing on adoption challenges:
- Cloud and AI Infrastructure track: Solid understanding of integrating Cisco data center solutions (ACI, HyperFlex, UCS, Nexus, MDS, Intersight, NDFC/NDI) with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience using APIs and programmability to connect Cisco solutions into existing customer ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Multiple advanced certifications (CCIE, CISM, CISSP); Cisco Certified Success Specialist certification strongly preferred.
- Experience contributing to the broader professional community, such as through shared frameworks, external presentations, or published thinking.
- Experience supporting the development of senior technical specialists and contributing to team-wide capability.
- Breadth of experience across multiple technical tracks (Networking, Security, Cloud & AI Infrastructure), with the ability to draw on cross-domain knowledge in customer conversations

Why Cisco?
#WeAreCisco, where each person is unique, but we bring our talents to work as a team and make a difference powering an inclusive future for all. We embrace digital, and help our customers implement change in their digital businesses. Some may think we’re “old” (36 years strong) and only about hardware, but we’re also a software company. And a security company. We even invented an intuitive network that adapts, predicts, learns and protects. No other company can do what we do – you can’t put us in a box! But “Digital Transformation” is an empty buzz phrase without a culture that allows for innovation, creativity, and yes, even failure (if you learn from it.) Day to day, we focus on the give and take. We give our best, give our egos a break, and give of ourselves (because giving back is built into our DNA.) We take accountability, bold steps, and take difference to heart. Customer Success Specialistとして、あなたは戦略的アドバイザーかつ技術の専門家として、製品の導入を加速し、Ciscoの顧客に対して測定可能なビジネス価値をもたらすための重点的な取り組みを主導します。顧客環境の基準設定からオンボーディングのロードマップ作成、経営層向けワークショップの実施、そしてCiscoの製品ロードマップに直接反映されるフィードバックの提供まで、導入の全過程をリードします。この役割での成功は、顧客が単に製品を購入するだけでなく、その価値を積極的に実現する段階へと進むことを意味し、あなたはその信頼されるガイドとなります。さらに、「顧客の声」として、製品ポートフォリオ全体にわたる課題や機会についてCiscoのエンジニアリングおよび製品管理チームに助言を行います。

主な業務内容：

- 顧客の多様なニーズに合わせた高影響のワークショップ、Expert-Insight-Series（EIS）セッション、Acceleratorsを主導し、基礎的な製品理解から高度な機能導入までを支援し、CX製品管理チームへ積極的にフィードバックを提供。
- 検証済みの導入フレームワークを適用し、顧客がCiscoソリューションの購入から望ましいビジネス成果の達成までのギャップを埋める支援を行い、環境の基準設定や包括的なオンボーディング計画の策定を推進。
- 技術利用率の低さや統合障壁などの導入リスクを特定し、顧客の期待管理と問題解決を迅速に行い、成功する顧客体験を確保。
- 導入計画、サイトマトリックス、多機能コミュニケーションを文書化し、プロジェクト関係者全員がオンボーディングの各段階で連携できる詳細なロードマップを構築。
- 顧客の戦略的・戦術的意思決定を支援し、アーキテクチャの主導やCisco検証済み設計の導入を通じて、長期的な製品活用の成功を確実に。

【必須（MUST）】
※以下のいずれか２−３つ
- 流暢な日本語（必須）
- セキュリティスタックの専門知識：Secure Access、Umbrella、DUO、ISE、次世代ファイアウォール（NGFW）、Secure Workload、XDR/SNAに関する高度な知識。
- クロスアーキテクチャ理解：セキュリティがSDWANおよびデータセンター（ACI）アーキテクチャとどのように統合されるかの深い理解。
- ライフサイクル管理：顧客要件の検証とグローバルエコシステム全体での高度なセキュリティ機能の継続的な活用推進における専門性。
- セキュリティコンサルティングまたは技術的カスタマーサクセスの分野で10～12年以上の経験。
- 工学またはコンピュータサイエンスの学士号または修士号。
- 複数の高度な認定資格（CISSPまたはCISM、CCIEが望ましい）。

【歓迎（WANT）】
- 工学、コンピュータサイエンス、または関連分野の修士号または同等の経験。

- 共有フレームワーク、外部プレゼンテーション、または公開された考え方を通じて、広範な専門コミュニティへの貢献経験。
- 上級技術スペシャリストの育成支援およびチーム全体の能力向上への貢献経験。
- ネットワーク、セキュリティ、クラウド＆AIインフラなど複数の技術トラックにわたる幅広い経験を持ち、顧客との会話でクロスドメインの知識を活用できる能力。

Meet the Team
The Cisco Customer Experience (CX) organisation is one of Cisco’s fastest-growing teams, with a clear purpose: helping customers get real, lasting value from their Cisco investments. We work at the crossroads of technical knowledge and business understanding, partnering with customers to improve how they operate and achieve outcomes that matter to them. The Customer Success Specialist (CSS) team is a collaborative group of technical advisors who bring deep product knowledge and a genuine curiosity about customer success; We work side-by-side with customers to guide them, not from the sidelines. We are part of a global community that shares adoption approaches and learning across three areas of focus: Networking, Security, and Cloud & AI Infrastructure. If you enjoy working through sophisticated technical challenges, contributing to how Cisco’s products improve over time, and collaborating with curious, knowledgeable colleagues, this team is a great fit.

Your Impact
As a Customer Success Specialist, you will serve as a strategic advisor and technical expert, leading targeted engagements that accelerate product adoption and drive measurable business value for Cisco’s customers. You will lead the full adoption journey, from baselining customer environments and building onboarding roadmaps to facilitating executive-level workshops and providing feedback that directly crafts Cisco’s product roadmap. Success in this role means customers move from purchasing a solution to actively realizing its value, with you as the trusted guide at every step. Your influence extends well beyond individual engagements: as the “voice of the customer,” your insights will advise Cisco Engineering and Product Management on challenges and opportunities across the product portfolio.

- Lead high-impact workshops, Expert-Insight-Series (EIS) sessions, and Accelerators tailored to diverse customer needs, from foundational product awareness to sophisticated feature adoption, while proactively providing feedback to CX Product Management to improve these offerings.
- Accelerate value realization by applying validated adoption frameworks to help customers bridge the gap between purchasing a Cisco solution and achieving their desired business outcomes, including baselining environments and developing comprehensive onboarding journeys.
- Identify and mitigate adoption risks, such as low technical usage or integration barriers, by handling customer expectations and resolving issues promptly to ensure a successful customer journey.
- Document adoption plans, site matrices, and multi-functional communications to build detailed roadmaps, ensuring all project collaborators remain aligned at every stage of the onboarding lifecycle.
- Guide customers on strategic and tactical decisions, lead architectural initiatives, and incorporate Cisco validated designs to ensure successful, long-term product utilization.

Minimum Qualifications
- Fluent Japanese proficiency
- Security Stack Mastery:   Expert-level knowledge of Secure Access, Umbrella, DUO, ISE, NGFW, Secure Workload, and XDR/SNA.
- Cross-Architecture:   Strong understanding of how security integrates with SDWAN and Data Center (ACI) architectures.
- Lifecycle Management:   Expert in verifying customer requirements and driving ongoing utilisation of advanced security features across global ecosystems.

- Experience:   10–12+ years in security consulting or technical customer success roles.
- Education:   Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science.
- Certifications:   Multiple advanced certifications (CISSP or CISM plus CCIE preferred).
- Demonstrate expert-level knowledge in the specialized technical tracks, focusing on adoption challenges:
- Security track: Solid understanding of Cisco Secure Access, Umbrella, DUO, ISE, Next Generation Firewall, Secure Workload, and XDR/SNA, with experience supporting customers through onboarding and into ongoing adoption of advanced security features.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Multiple advanced certifications (CCIE, CISM, CISSP); Cisco Certified Success Specialist certification strongly preferred.
- Experience contributing to the broader professional community, such as through shared frameworks, external presentations, or published thinking.
- Experience supporting the development of senior technical specialists and contributing to team-wide capability.
- Breadth of experience across multiple technical tracks (Networking, Security, Cloud & AI Infrastructure), with the ability to draw on cross-domain knowledge in customer conversations

Why Cisco?
#WeAreCisco, where each person is unique, but we bring our talents to work as a team and make a difference powering an inclusive future for all. But “Digital Transformation” is an empty buzz phrase without a culture that allows for innovation, creativity, and yes, even failure (if you learn from it.) Day to day, we focus on the give and take. We give our best, give our egos a break, and give of ourselves (because giving back is built into our DNA.) We take accountability, bold steps, and take difference to heart. Because without diversity of thought and a dedication to equality for all, there is no moving forward. So, you have colorful hair? Don’t care. Tattoos? Show off your ink. Like polka dots? That’s cool. Pop culture geek? Many of us are. Passion for technology and world changing? Be you, with us!

Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We're looking for a highly experienced Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive Cisco's expansion in the Social Infrastructure sector, with a focus on critical industries such as Power, Railways, and Roads. As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll draw on deep industry expertise and a strong professional network—spanning customers, partners, and the broader industry ecosystem—to shape and win strategic proposal opportunities. You'll serve as a key bridge between the Japanese market and Cisco's global organization, making sure our global strategies are effectively localized and executed to meet the unique demands of critical infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities
- Industry-Specific Demand Generation: Lead enterprise-wide demand generation strategies tailored to the complex needs of the Social Infrastructure sector, strengthening Cisco's presence across both new and existing solution offerings.
- Strategic Relationship Management: Leverage your extensive network among customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to build and sustain executive-level relationships that secure long-term business commitments.
- Global Collaboration: Work closely with Cisco's global teams to share best practices, align on cross-domain solutions, and drive global campaigns within the Japanese market. Fluency in both Japanese and English is essential — Japanese to engage effectively with local customers and partners, and English to communicate and align strategically with global stakeholders.
- Deal Shaping & Complex Proposals: Architect innovative deal structures for high-stakes opportunities (typically >$1M), tailoring solutions to meet both customer objectives and Cisco's business goals within the long, complex sales cycles typical of critical infrastructure.

Qualifications
- Industry Expertise: Proven track record in business development or solution sales within the Social Infrastructure sector (e.g., Power/Utilities, Railway, Road/Transportation).
- Network: A strong, established professional network among customers, partners, and industry bodies, with a demonstrated ability to reach and influence key decision-makers.
- Communication Skills: Business-level fluency in both Japanese and English (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate effectively with local stakeholders as well as global Cisco teams.
- Leadership: Proven ability to lead complex projects and drive governance across internal and external stakeholders.
- Education: No specific degree required. We prioritize proven industry experience, professional achievements, and a demonstrated ability to drive business growth in critical infrastructure.

Success Measures
- Revenue Growth: Drive increased sales revenue for new and existing products within target infrastructure verticals.

jobs.title: Country Sales Leader, Splunk Austria
jobs.description:
Splunk , a Cisco company, is building a safer and more resilient digital world with an end-to-end full stack platform made for a hybrid, multi-cloud world. Leading enterprises use our unified security and observability platform to keep their digital systems secure and reliable. Our customers love our technology, but it's our caring employees that make Splunk stand out as an amazing career destination. No matter where in the world or what level of the organization, we approach our work with kindness. So, bring your work experience, problem-solving skills and talent, of course, but also bring your joy, your passion and all the things that make you, you. Come help organizations be their best, while you reach new heights with a team that has your back.

Role Summary:

We are seeking an outstanding Country Sales Leader, Splunk Austria to lead our business operations and market presence for Splunk in Austria. In this role, you will be responsible for the overall success of the Austrian market, driving significant growth across a diverse portfolio of enterprise customers. You will define and execute the country-level go-to-market strategy, cultivate high-level executive relationships, and position Splunk as a strategic partner to help our customers accelerate their digital resilience and business transformation.

We are looking for an inspiring, senior-level leader with a proven track record of managing country operations, leading high-performing teams, and securing complex, multi-million-dollar enterprise engagements. You possess the strategic vision to navigate the Austrian market landscape, build trusted C-level relationships, and orchestrate cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding business outcomes. You are an expert in disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and fostering sustainable, long-term growth. You bring the executive presence, strategic acumen, and leadership to inspire your team while consistently delivering exceptional results.

Key Focus Areas: What you'll get to do!
- Country Leadership & Talent Development:  Lead, scale, and coach a high-performing team. Focus on hiring, onboarding, and continuous professional development to foster a strong team ethos and maximize both individual and collective performance across the Austrian organization.

- Strategic Market Management:  Full ownership of the Austrian market strategy and execution. Consistently overachieve iACV targets by driving accuracy and predictability in forecasting, pipeline oversight, and long-term business planning.

- Cross-Functional Orchestration:  Lead virtual teams by driving alignment across Sales Engineering, Business Value Consulting, Product Advisory, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success. Leverage channel and technology partners to maximize market effectiveness, scale, and solution delivery.

- Sales Methodology & Negotiation:  Expert application of MEDDPICC, Value-Based Selling, and Pain Chains. Actively lead complex deal negotiations and mentor the team to sell on value, expand deal sizes, and maximize business impact for our customers.

- Operational Excellence & KPI Management:  Monitor and analyze regional KPIs to continuously improve sales performance. Develop and implement effective sales processes and best practices to ensure regional efficiency and scalability.

- Corporate Citizenship & Stakeholder Alignment:  Act as the primary liaison for the Austrian market, serving as a key voice for the region to internal departments (Product Management, Marketing, Global Sales). Provide timely, insightful input to drive corporate initiatives and ensure a transparent, two-way flow of communication.

Must-have Qualifications:
- Extensive experience in building and managing high-performing sales teams, with the ability and desire to grow and scale operations.

- Significant experience in direct and channel selling to Enterprise and Strategic Accounts.

- Existing and reliable relationships within the Austrian market that help drive growth and demonstrate an ability to expand that professional network.

- Proven experience in engaging with C-level executives and senior management in large-scale organizations.

- Track record of closing six and seven-figure TCV software licensing deals.

- Deep understanding and expertise in pipeline generation and management within a fast-paced environment.

- Strong executive presence, professional bearing, and polish.

- Ability to maintain an accurate sales forecast, deliver on commitments, and drive new business growth.

jobs.title: Customer Success Technical Leader (Technical Account Manager : Splunk)
jobs.description:
仕事内容Customer Success Security Area TAMとして、あなたは顧客に情熱を持ち、すべての顧客の要望が最大限の影響をもたらすようにソリューションを推進し、チームとともに最高の成果を共有します。Splunkの専門家として、アカウントチームや顧客が当社のプラットフォームを最適に活用できるよう理解し、適応し、導く役割を担います。一緒に挑戦していきましょう！

主な責任は、Splunkのセキュリティライセンス製品（Enterprise Security、UBA、SOARなど）に精通し、特定のエリアにおいてカスタマーサクセスや技術チームと連携して顧客の価値実現を支援することです。具体的には、オンボーディングやワークショップの実施、使用状況の監査と問題の是正、セキュリティユースケースの計画・開発、製品機能の活用促進などを行います。また、顧客の技術的課題を先回りして特定・解決し、最大90日間の戦略的技術コンサルティングを提供し、アカウントチームや顧客と協力して最適なプラットフォーム活用を導きます。さらに、リスクアカウントの管理や優先事項の調整も担当します。

【必須（MUST）】
- 流暢な日本語
- Splunk Enterprise Securityの設定、管理、開発に関する深い技術知識。
- 多様なデータソースの統合・正規化経験、Common Information Model（CIM）の理解。
- Search Processing Language（SPL）を用いた相関検索やリスクベースのアラートルールの開発経験。

【歓迎（WANT）】
- UBA/UEBAやSOARの専門知識。
- セキュリティ運用、フォレンジクス、脅威ハンティング、内部脅威、コンプライアンスの知識。
- NIST CSF、CIS、HIPAA、PCI DSSなどのセキュリティフレームワークの理解。
- GIAC、CISSP、OSCPなどの業界標準のセキュリティ資格。
- オンプレミスおよびクラウド（AWS、Azure、GCP）環境のエンタープライズアーキテクチャ理解。
- SplunkのES実装認定やSOARコンサルタント資格。

Meet the Team
As a Customer Success Security Area TAM, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.
Are you up for the challenge?
Responsibilities:
- Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response).
- Aligned to a specific Area to strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
- Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to: - Onboarding & Enablement​ – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones.​
- Health Review & Remediation ​- audit usage, indexes, data models, assets/identities, dashboards, correlation searches, notable events, frameworks, etc. and remediate identified issues​.
- Security Use Case Activation​ - planning & development of detections/analytics (e.g. identify MITRE ATT&CK coverage gaps, integrate/normalize data, drive CIM compliance, write custom SPL, etc.)​.
- Feature/Framework/Product Activation ​(e.g. Risk Base-Alerting, Threat Intel, Threat Hunt, UBA/UEBA, SOAR/Automation, etc.).
- Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives and Solution Architects on Security-related adoption/use case work opportunity.
- Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers on health-related work opportunity related to Security products.
- Scoping the level of effort and developing a technical action plan to address the technical situation based on your assessment.

- Proactively engage Area aligned CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts/area themes.
- Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

Customer Success Area TAM, you will:
- Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
- Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
- Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment.
- Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of the Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR. Provide recommendations for improving customer’s technical health.
- Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
- Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
- Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
- Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
- Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
- Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
- Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

Minimum Qualifications
- Fluent Japanese proficiency
- Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.
- Data Management: Experience with integrating and normalising data from diverse sources. Understanding of the Common Information Model (CIM) and experience with data onboarding, including forwarding architecture and technical add-ons.
- Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.

Preferred Qualifications
- Additional Security Products/Applications: Expertise in UBA/UEBA and/or SOAR.
- Cybersecurity Domain: Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
- Cybersecurity Frameworks: Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
- Industry Standard Security Certifications:  GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
- Infrastructure: Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Splunk Certifications/Accreditations: ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II

Soft Skills
- Trusted technical advisor with the ability to manage assigned tickets and Area aligned priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
- Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
- Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
- Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to manage highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
- Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of Area management, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
- Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
- Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.
- Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.
- Ability to balance multiple account teams, customers and competing priorities effectively.

Why Cisco?
#WeAreCisco, where each person is unique, but we bring our talents to work as a team and make a difference powering an inclusive future for all. We embrace digital, and help our customers implement change in their digital businesses. Some may think we’re “old” (36 years strong) and only about hardware, but we’re also a software company. And a security company. We even invented an intuitive network that adapts, predicts, learns and protects. No other company can do what we do – you can’t put us in a box! But “Digital Transformation” is an empty buzz phrase without a culture that allows for innovation, creativity, and yes, even failure (if you learn from it.) Day to day, we focus on the give and take. We give our best, give our egos a break, and give of ourselves (because giving back is built into our DNA.) We take accountability, bold steps, and take difference to heart. Because without diversity of thought and a dedication to equality for all, there is no moving forward. So, you have colorful hair? Don’t care. Tattoos? Show off your ink. Like polka dots? That’s cool. Pop culture geek? Many of us are. Passion for technology and world changing? Be you, with us!

Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The successful applicant will be performing work on US Government classified environments, and therefore, must be a U.S. Person (i.e., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, asylee, or refugee). This position will perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen on U.S. soil. The successful applicant must have a current US Government DOD Security Clearance.

Meet the Team
The Customer Success Specialist (CSS) role ensures the adoption of software and value realization that lead to successful service renewals and business growth by leveraging AI-driven insights and a thorough understanding of customer environments and deployments to tailor adoption strategies. Our CSS’s are an integral part of the Customer Experience (CX) team delivering proactive Technical Adoption Plans (TAPs) to our customers. We combine the power of Cisco Analytics and Knowledge with the outstanding technical expertise and consulting (that’s you) to drive value, innovation, and adoption in our customer’s network. We help them to reduce risk, drive innovation, and enhance their network to meet business objectives. We are the customer’s trusted advisor and expert, helping the customer understand their network, reduce risks, and take advantage of the technology. We work closely with Cisco Engineering to advocate for innovation for our customer and as a liaison, share what is coming with our customers to help them be the groundbreakers of technology.

Your Impact
As a Customer Success Specialist, you will drive solutions-based, technical and complex adoption strategies across large, strategic customer segments, managing high-complexity enterprise deployments where AI-analytics inform both planning and execution.
You will regularly lead customized technical enablement initiatives such as executive briefings, architecture-specific workshops, and multi-functional onboarding programs.

You will work directly with our customers and gain direct experience and exposure into their networks. You will collaborate on a variety of projects that have a real impact on the lives of Veterans and military service members. We will value your ideas and perspective on how to get things done. You will work on network infrastructures and help to deliver business solutions and technology solutions from data, security, mobility, and cloud.

- 8 years relevant experience in Cisco networking (Emphasis on Security. Enterprise Networking, Data Center, Full Scope Observability (FSO) and AI are a plus).
- Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE), Cisco Certified Networking Professional (CCNP) or equivalent skills (Security, Enterprise Networking).
- Comfortable speaking in front customers, both live and via video, presenting Cisco solutions with confidence.

- Be experienced delivering Cisco standard methodologies within our customer's infrastructure.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist - NX
jobs.description:
職務概要
この役割は、AIを活用した洞察と顧客環境・導入状況の深い理解をもとに、ソフトウェアの導入促進と価値実現を支援し、契約更新やビジネス成長につなげることを目的としています。
主なミッション
- 技術的な導入計画（TAP）を戦略的に策定・推進し、顧客の目標に沿ったCisco技術の最大活用を促進します。
- 導入進捗の確認や成果達成に向けたワークショップを主導し、成功したオンボーディングと契約更新を実現します。
- 1対多の技術啓発セッション（Expert Insight Series）を企画・実施し、最新のCisco技術や業界動向を踏まえた専門的なガイダンスを提供します。
- 顧客や社内関係者と連携し、AIや戦略的洞察を活用して導入促進や製品改善に貢献します。

主な業務内容
戦略的導入計画の推進
- 大規模かつ複雑な顧客導入において、AI分析を活用しながら技術的な導入戦略を策定・実行します。
- 複数チーム間での導入計画の統合を管理し、アカウント戦略と連携させます。
- 導入状況のレビューや市場動向の分析を行い、計画を更新します。
- 営業やCXリーダーと協働し、契約更新や拡大に向けた導入ジャーニーを共創します。

顧客対応とアドバイザリー
- 顧客の上級リーダーに対し信頼されるアドバイザーとして、Cisco技術とビジネス成果の整合を支援します。
- カスタマイズした技術啓発やワークショップを主導し、多様な顧客ニーズに対応します。
- 複雑な技術内容をわかりやすく伝え、顧客の理解を促進します。
- 複数の関係者を巻き込み、一貫した顧客体験を提供します。

技術専門性とエバンジェリズム
- 複数製品にまたがる深い技術知識を持ち、AIや高度なテレメトリを活用した複雑な検証環境を設計・運用します。
- フィールドからのフィードバックを製品改善に繋げる技術伝道師として活動します。
- 1対多の技術シリーズを企画・実施し、その効果を測定します。

リーダーシップと横断的連携
- 複数チームや地域にまたがる顧客成功プログラムのビジョンと方向性を示し、AIによる生産性向上を推進します。
- グローバルなベストプラクティスの展開や顧客成果の向上に向けた横断的な取り組みをリードします。
- シニア人材やチームリーダーのメンターとして、複雑な顧客課題や組織戦略を支援します。
- CSSコミュニティの代表として、計画や意思決定の場に参画します。

必須条件
- 日本語が流暢であること
- 8年以上の関連経験（修士号や博士号保持者は経験年数が少なくても可）
- CCIEなどの専門的な資格または同等の業界認定資格を有すること

Role Overview

jobs.description:

As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.

Are you up for the challenge?

Responsibilities:
- Skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response)
- Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk’s Core licensed product, such as Enterprise and Cloud.
- Strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
- Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to: - Onboarding & Enablement – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones
- Health Review & Remediation
- Security Use Case Activation
- Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers to review and assess their account’s health situation, with an emphasis on accounts that have telemetry risk signals and/or 6 months from renewal date.
- Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives on adoption/use case-related work opportunity.
- Proactively engage CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts themes.
- Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you Will
- Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
- Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
- Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a dynamic environment.
- Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of Splunk Platform and Splunk Enterprise Security. Provide recommendations for a customer’s overall technical health.
- Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
- Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
- Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
- Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
- Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
- Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
- Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

Minimum Qualifications

- Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.

- Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.
- Strong Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and Splunk Core product feature experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Cybersecurity Domain:  Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
- Cybersecurity Frameworks:  Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
- Industry Standard Security Certifications:  GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
- Infrastructure:  Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Splunk Certifications/Accreditations:  ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II
- Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments
- Statistical and analytical modeling skills are a plus.
- Proficiency with scripting languages (bash), application development (Java, Python, .NET), databases, and analytical tools.
- Hands-on experience with Splunk product implementation of focus and Splunk Cloud.
- Experience with cloud migration projects.
- Solid experience in technical consulting or big-data analytics.

Soft Skills
- Trusted technical advisor with the ability to manage assigned tickets and priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
- Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
- Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
- Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to manage highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
- Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of the customers, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
- Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
- Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.
- Strong customer-facing skills to instill confidence and guide towards resolution.
- Ability to balance multiple account teams, customers and competing priorities effectively.

Customer Experience (CX) Customer Success Specialists (CSS) are a team of extraordinary technical guides whose #1 focus is to deliver exclusive customer experience. We help solve business challenges with network-centric solutions that accelerate customer and partner success and dedication. As a team we know that in engineering and customer success, you can only be successful together, so we emphasize a culture of helping each other, working together, winning together and having fun together.
As a CSS team we help customers adopt and expand Cisco solutions by showing impact on the customer’s business goals. Maintaining an end-to-end lens, as CSSs we partner closely with Customer Success Executives, Success Programs Managers, sales accounts teams, delivery teams, partners and others to affect adoption and renewals.

Your Impact:
