- It proactively develops and orchestrates technical adoption planning (TAP) execution, creating and driving TAPs that align with customer goals to maximize technology investments and promote the full utilization of Cisco technologies, with designated Customer Success Specialists (CSS) typically owning TAP creation and pooled CSSs contributing architecture-specific expertise.

- Configures and maintains low to moderately complex test environments for customer demos, troubleshooting basic issues to support effective sessions
- Uses telemetry and AI-driven insights to identify opportunities for improvement
- Shares customer feedback and competitive observations to support product and service enhancements

- Contributes to customer strategy by suggesting improvements, piloting new approaches
- Fosters cross-functional collaboration by connecting with support, sales, or engineering to resolve customer issues
- You possess practical technical proficiency with Data Centre technologies.
- You love customer interactions and understand customer needs and align architectural and vertical expertise to multi-functional teams
- You are able to explain technical concepts, give clients guidance and vision about the solution. You have a thorough understanding of the aligned technology/specialization areas, including features and use cases.
- You have industry recognized certifications and an ability to motivate change through innovation.

- In-depth knowledge with the following technology and architecture areas: DC Networking, Cisco ACI, VXLAN, DC compute solutions such as Intersight, UCS, and understanding of DC automation and application development

- Deep technical knowledge with ability to understand and connect customer use cases/plans with Cisco solutions and how Cisco solutions can be optimally applied in a customer’s environment to accelerate business value.
- Ability to utilize moderate to complex lab environments to demonstrate the resolution of barriers across the entire customer lifecycle for Cisco Datacenter products & solutions.

- BS/BA Engineering, B.Tech/ B.E/ M.Tech/ MCA in Computer Science or equivalent.
- 6+ years of experience in technical consulting or direct customer interfacing role with a deep understanding of industry best practices related to the datacenter domain.

The Splunk Field Marketing team is a dynamic, results-driven group responsible for building strong APJC marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and demand for Splunk’s groundbreaking solutions. jobs.description:
募集職種：シニア・ビジネスデベロップメント・マネージャー（自動車・製造業担当／日本）

職務概要
本ポジションは、日本における自動車および製造業向けに、シスコの製品・サービス・ソリューションの市場開拓を主導する役割を担います。短期および中長期的な販売機会を特定し、専門家として戦略的な提案を策定します。
フィールドセールス、各事業ユニット、プロダクト/サービススペシャリスト、エンジニアリング、セキュリティ、マーケティング、およびエコシステムパートナーと連携し、需要創出と質の高い商談構築を行います。既存アカウントの拡大に加え、新規顧客との関係構築を通じてビジネスを成長させることがミッションです。
IT部門だけでなく、生産技術、製造現場、工場自動化（FA）、サイバーセキュリティ、OT（運用技術）部門の経営層との強固な関係を構築し、製造業特有のニーズをシスコのソリューション、商用モデル、ビジネス機会へと翻訳し、実現させます。
職務の詳細（What You’ll Do）
- 需要創出と市場開拓 : 新興ソリューションやクロスドメイン案件の需要創出を主導。
- 経営層とのリレーション : 自動車・製造業界の経営層と信頼関係を構築し、中長期的なコミットメントを獲得。
- 多部門連携 : 企業IT部門に加え、生産技術、FA、サイバーセキュリティ、OTチームへ深くアプローチし、シスコのネットワーク、セキュリティ、オブザーバビリティ、エッジ、データ、AI機能を活用したソリューションを提案。
- 案件形成 : 質の高いパイプラインを構築し、リード転換率を向上。複雑な案件構造を最適化し、導入を加速させる新たな消費モデル（Consumption Models）を開発。
- エコシステム構築 : 機械メーカー、機器メーカー、システムインテグレーター、テクノロジーパートナーと連携し、共同ソリューションやリファレンスアーキテクチャを策定。
- フィジカルAIの推進 : AI搭載の機械、ロボット、カメラ、センサー、車両、生産システムとセキュアなデジタルインフラを接続し、スマートマニュファクチャリングを推進。
- サイバーセキュリティ : Mythos関連を含む、自動車・産業向けサイバーセキュリティのビジネス開発をリードし、工場や車両、AI運用に向けたスケーラブルなソリューションを提供。
- 業界活動とガバナンス : 業界団体やワーキンググループを通じたフィジカルAI、データ、エネルギー管理の推進。ガバナンスの主導およびベストプラクティスの共有、成功事例（ライトハウスプロジェクト）の創出。

求める人物像とスキル
【必須要件（Minimum Qualifications）】
- 学士号取得者：関連業務経験12年以上
- 修士号取得者：関連業務経験8年以上
- 博士号取得者：関連業務経験5年以上
- または、上記と同等の実務経験

【歓迎要件（Preferred Qualifications）】
- 日本の自動車・製造業界における深い知見およびネットワーク
- 日本の自動車メーカーや製造企業に対するビジネス開発またはソリューション営業経験
- 生産技術、FA、OT、サイバーセキュリティ部門へのアプローチ経験
- 製造現場の要件を技術的ソリューションとビジネス成果へ落とし込む能力
- 機械メーカーやシステムインテグレーターとのエコシステム構築経験
- スマートマニュファクチャリング、IT/OTコンバージェンス、産業サイバーセキュリティ、フィジカルAI等の知識
- 複雑な100万ドル規模の案件形成経験
- 経営層と対等に渡り合えるコミュニケーション能力およびクロスファンクショナルなリーダーシップ
- 日本語および英語でのビジネスレベル以上のコミュニケーション能力

成功の評価指標（Success Measures）
- 新規および既存ソリューションからの収益成長
- 質の高い案件のパイプライン増加
- 100万ドルを超える大規模案件の創出と進捗
- 競合からのリプレイスおよび顧客内シェアの拡大
- IT部門から生産技術・OT・セキュリティ領域への顧客基盤の拡大
- エコシステムパートナーとの共同ソリューションおよび再現性のあるビジネスモデルの確立
- 業界団体における影響力の拡大および業界内でのシスコのポジショニング強化

jobs.description:
Meet the Team
The MSP Sales & Go-to-Market Lead – MEA-South is an individual contributor responsible for accelerating and scaling Splunk’s business with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) across the region.

This role translates the broader EMEA MSP strategy into a focused regional go-to-market and sales execution plan. The successful candidate will support the development and growth of strategic MSP partnerships that generate sustainable pipeline, recurring revenue, and new customer acquisition for Splunk.

The role will drive the adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program and ensure that Splunk is embedded or “designed in” within partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings.

The MSP Sales & Go-to-Market Lead does not own or manage the partner relationship. Partner ownership and accountability remain with the respective Partner Development Manager (PDM) or Partner Sales Manager (PSM). This role provides MSP expertise, direction, and execution support to help partner and sales teams build and scale successful MSP motions.

Your Impact
Regional MSP Strategy and Go-to-Market
- Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligned with the overall EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities.
- Ensure that priority partners have a clear MSP strategy and execution plan embedded within the broader partner plans owned by the respective PDMs and PSMs.
- Support PDMs and PSMs in defining MSP growth plans, revenue ambitions, enablement requirements, service-development priorities, and joint go-to-market activities.
- Build a clear scale plan to expand the regional MSP ecosystem by onboarding new partners, growing existing MSP capabilities, and driving new customer acquisition.
- Identify priority markets, customer segments, industry verticals, and MSP propositions with the strongest potential for scalable growth.
- Maintain a strong understanding of regional market dynamics, competition, regulation, customer demand, and emerging managed-service trends.

Sales and Business Development
- Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities across the region in close collaboration with PDMs, PSMs, and Splunk sales teams.
- Develop campaigns and initiatives that create MSP pipeline, generate net-new logos, and support recurring-revenue growth.
- Maintain visibility of the regional MSP pipeline and regularly review progress, performance, and execution with sales and partner teams.
- Support joint account planning and opportunity development with key strategic MSP partners.
- Work closely with regional and global MSP sales teams to align priorities, share best practices, and accelerate strategic opportunities.
- Support complex MSP opportunities and collaborate with the EMEA team to remove commercial, operational, contractual, or organizational barriers.
- Ensure that partner ownership, execution accountability, and opportunity follow-up remain clearly assigned to the relevant PDM, PSM, and sales teams.

Splunk MSP Program and Enablement
- Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program.
- Act as the regional MSP subject-matter expert and advocate for the program across partner and sales organizations.
- Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics.

- Work closely with the EMEA MSP team to identify program improvements required to address regional market needs.

- Work closely with PDMs, PSMs, PTMs, marketing, legal, finance, operations, and the EMEA and global MSP teams.
- Prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

- Help resolve complex pricing, licensing, contractual, and route-to-market considerations.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Customer Success Specialist - Security
jobs.description:
職務内容

このロールは、AIを活用したインサイトと、顧客環境・導入状況の深い理解をもとに最適な活用（アダプション）戦略を組み立て、ソフトウェアの定着と価値実現を推進することで、契約更新とビジネス成長につなげる役割です。

具体的には、Technical Adoption Planning（TAP）の策定と実行を自ら先回りして組み立て、顧客のゴールに沿ったTAPを作成・推進することで、顧客のテクノロジー投資効果を最大化し、シスコ製品を余すところなく活用してもらえる状態を目指します。なお、TAPの作成は基本的にDesignated CSSが担い、Pooled CSSはアーキテクチャ固有の専門知識を提供する形で貢献します。
また、アラインメントワークショップをファシリテートして活用状況の進捗をレビューし、顧客が期待する成果（アウトカム）とベネフィットの実現を後押しします。これがオンボーディング、アダプション、そして契約更新の成功につながっていきます。

スケールの観点では、高度な1:Many型の技術イネーブルメントである「Expert Insight Series」を企画・提供してインパクトを広げます。AIの最新動向を含むシスコテクノロジー、競合環境、業界トレンドを常にキャッチアップし、専門家としてのガイダンスを提供するとともに、ステークホルダー向けワークショップにも参加し、アダプションビジネスの現状（共通の課題や市場トレンドなど）を言語化して伝えます。

さらに、1:1の顧客エンゲージメントやコミュニティイベントにも関わり、CXM（Customer Experience Manager）やCSM（Customer Success Manager）のTAP策定・実行をサポートします。その中で、経営層や顧客の技術的な意思決定に影響を与え、信頼されるアドバイザーとしての関係を築いていきます。
加えて、Customer Successチーム、アカウントチーム、セールス、パートナー、その他GTM関連の各チームと連携し、AIと戦略的インサイトを活用しながら顧客のアダプション促進、製品に関する懸念への対応、価値とビジネス成果につながるユースケースの発掘を進めます。顧客とシスコのプロダクトチームの間に立つ「テクノロジーエバンジェリスト」として、製品開発・改善に活かせるフィードバックを届け、顧客から挙がった構造的な製品課題についてはプロダクトチームとの連携を主導し、ユーザビリティとサービサビリティの向上を推進します。

具体的な業務内容
- 複数製品・複数テクノロジーにまたがる複雑な導入案件を含む、相当規模の顧客ポートフォリオのアダプションを担当。担当アーキテクチャを軸に、隣接アーキテクチャの知見も活かしつつ、AIツールを用いてアダプション上の課題を予測し、戦略を最適化します
- 大規模なオーディエンスや複数アーキテクチャを対象とした、幅広く高度なイネーブルメント施策を設計・提供。顧客の成熟度、ビジネス優先事項、技術スタックに合わせてセッションをカスタマイズします
- 顧客組織内に社内チャンピオンを育て、多様なステークホルダーと関わりながら、相互の成長につながる関係性を強化します
- TAPの作成と実行をオーナーとして担い、社内チームやパートナーと連携して、アダプション活動がタイムリーかつ的確で、効果を測定できる状態を担保します
- セッションのゴールをAIから得た示唆をもとに設定し、グローバルチームと協働して一貫したサポートを提供することで、顧客の期待値をマネジメントします
- 中級レベルのデモ環境を構築・活用してコンサルテーションを実施し、顧客のビジネス課題を分析して解決策を提案します
- テレメトリや利用状況データからアダプションのギャップを特定し、顧客に先回りして働きかけて解消します
- フィードバックを収集し関連チームに共有することで製品改善にインプットを行い、継続的な価値創出のためのデータツールの活用を促進します
- 共通ニーズに対して、1:Many型のイネーブルメント（定期開催のExpert Insight形式のセッション）を導入します
- アダプション計画を製品のケイパビリティと顧客のアウトカムに紐づけ、ビジネスニーズを技術的なステップに翻訳します（例：インシデントアラートを削減するための特定アラート、ダッシュボード、ワークフローの有効化）
- 顧客のトポロジーを再現した、中程度に複雑なラボを構築・運用し、本番展開前に連携動作やエッジケースを検証します
- 再利用可能なスクリプトやチェックリストを作成し、よくある作業（ベースライン設定、ヘルスチェックなど）を効率化します
- 現場から得たインサイトを集約し、製品改善やユーザビリティ・サービサビリティの向上に反映させます
- 技術的な知見をもとに改善提案を行い、サービスチームと協働してアダプション手法そのものを進化させ、イノベーションを推進します
- 主要アカウントについて、部門横断のチーム（IT、セキュリティ、運用など）をカスタマーサクセスのゴールに向けて一枚岩にまとめます
- ワークショップやワーキンググループをファシリテート・リードし、アダプション推進と顧客課題の解決を図ります
- プロセス改善や新プログラムの立ち上げなど、CX組織内の戦略的な取り組みを、AIを取り入れながら主導します
- シニアCSSのメンタリングを行い、ナレッジシェアのセッションやコミュニティフォーラムをリードします

応募要件（Minimum Qualifications）
- 流暢な日本語
- 学士号＋関連実務経験7年以上、または修士号＋4年以上、または博士号＋1年以上、もしくは同等の関連実務経験
- プロフェッショナルレベルの認定資格（CCNPなど）または同等の関連資格を保有していること

This role ensures the adoption of software and value realization that lead to successful renewals and business growth by leveraging AI-driven insights and a thorough understanding of customer environments and deployments to tailor adoption strategies.

It proactively develops and orchestrates technical adoption planning (TAP) execution, creating and driving TAPs that align with customer goals to maximize technology investments and promote the full utilization of Cisco technologies, with designated CSSs typically owning TAP creation and pooled CSSs contributing architecture-specific expertise. The position facilitates alignment workshops to review adoption progress and drive expected customer outcomes and benefits, resulting in successful onboarding, adoption, and renewals.

It drives scale impact by creating and delivering advanced 1:many technical enablement Expert Insight Series, stays current with the latest Cisco technologies including AI advancements, the competitive landscape, and industry trends to provide expert guidance, and participates in stakeholder workshops to articulate the state of the adoption business, including common barriers and market trends.

The role is also involved in 1:1 customer engagements and community events, supporting Customer Experience Managers (CXMs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) in TAP and execution, while influencing executive and customer technical decision-making and fostering trusted advisory relationships. Additionally, the position collaborates with Customer Success Teams, Accounts, Sales, Partners, and others in GTM, leveraging AI and strategic insights to enhance customer adoption, address product concerns, and identify use cases that drive value and business outcomes. It acts as a technology evangelist between customers and Cisco's product teams, providing feedback to inform product development and enhancements, and leads collaboration with Product teams to address systemic product challenges identified by customers, driving usability and serviceability enhancements.

What You'll Do:
•Manages adoption for a significant-size portfolio of customers, often involving complex or multi-product and multi-technology deployments, across an architecture; may leverage knowledge of adjacent architectures and draws on AI-tools to predict adoption challenges and optimize strategy
•Designs and delivers broad, sophisticated enablement initiatives across large audiences and multiple architectures, tailoring sessions to customer maturity, business priorities, and technology stack
•Builds internal champions within customer organizations, and interacts with diverse stakeholders, enhancing relationships to drive mutual growth
•Owns TAP creation and execution, coordinating across internal teams and partners to ensure adoption activities are timely, relevant, and measurable
•Manages customer expectations by setting AI-informed goals for sessions and collaborating with global teams to deliver consistent support
•Sets up and uses intermediate demo environments to conduct consultations, analyzing customer business challenges to recommend solutions
•Uses telemetry and usage data to identify gaps in adoption, and proactively engages customers to address them
•Provides input on product enhancements by collecting and sharing feedback with relevant teams, while promoting data tools for ongoing value
•Introduces 1:many enablement (recurring Expert Insight-style sessions) for common needs
•Aligns adoption plans with product capabilities and customer outcomes, translating business needs into technical steps (e.g., enable specific alerts, dashboards, and workflows to reduce incident alert)
•Builds and runs moderately complex labs mirroring customer topology; validates integrations and edge cases before rollout
•Creates reusable scripts/checklists to speed up common tasks (e.g., baseline configuration, health checks)
•Consolidates field-driven insights to influence product enhancements and improve usability and serviceability
•Drives innovation by suggesting changes based on technical insights, partnering with service teams to enhance adoption methods
•Aligns cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, security, operations) on customer success goals for key accounts
•Facilitates and leads workshops or working groups to drive adoption and solve customer challenges
•Drives strategic initiatives within the CX organization, such as process improvements or new program launches by incorporating AI to optimize outcomes
•Mentors senior CSSs and leads knowledge-sharing sessions or community forums

Minimum Qualifications
Fluent Japanese
Bachelors + 7 years of related experience, or

jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/24/2026 Location:  San Jose, California
Work Model:  Hybrid in San Jose office
Scope:  Global
Travel:  Required
Reports To:  Senior Director, Real Estate Strategy and Planning

Meet the Team

Cisco's Workplace Resources (WPR) group is responsible for managing the physical and digital environments that support Cisco employees globally. Our primary focus is on creating and maintaining a productive, safe, and efficient workplace experience.

The Director of Real Estate Global Asset Management leads the global front-end strategy, highest-and-best-use analysis, site selection and disposition, Real Estate due diligence, entitlement, development and master planning support for Cisco’s major owned-real estate assets and large campuses.

Your Impact

This role is responsible for maintaining and increasing Cisco’s owned real estate asset and large campus values.  The Director is responsible for advising on how the company’s owned real estate and large campus portfolio, should best be used, repositioned, reinvested in, expanded, contracted, leased against, or sold to support Cisco’s business strategy. The role will translate business needs, portfolio data, financial inputs, operational requirements, and market conditions into clear recommendations for investment and portfolio governance decisions.
The role fills a critical gap by bringing together real estate development planning, portfolio strategy, land-use, entitlement, due diligence, and highest-and-best-use evaluation to drive global owned asset values and portfolio optimization decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

- Lead the owned and large campus-portfolio optimization and global real estate asset management function across Cisco’s global real estate portfolio.

- Lead and develop a small team focused on portfolio strategy, asset optimization, development and disposition planning, due diligence, entitlements, financial and risk analysis, and consultant coordination.

- Analyze the existing owned real estate portfolio to identify highest-and-best-use opportunities, constraints, risks, and long-term strategic options.

- Partner with WPR’s Global Business Partners to understand long-range business needs, growth plans, operating requirements, and location priorities.

- Evaluate whether new business demand should be met through existing owned assets, leased alternatives, new real estate acquisitions, redevelopment, repositioning, or disposition, while balancing and maintaining the best asset values for Cisco.

- Coordinate with Finance, Accounting and Tax to evaluate depreciation, book value, capital investment, operating cost, impairment, and financial, accounting and tax implications of hold, sell, reinvest, reposition, lease, or acquire scenarios.

- Assess talent, workforce, location strategy, operational adjacency, infrastructure, market, regulatory, and business-continuity considerations.

- Prepare hold / sell / reinvest / reposition / redevelop / lease / acquire recommendations for portfolio governance approval by Senior Leadership.

- Source and evaluate new land or property opportunities when existing assets are not the right strategic fit.

- Lead acquisition and disposition due diligence for property and land, including zoning, entitlement feasibility, title, survey, infrastructure, appraisals, market analysis, development risk and support environmental and energy engagements.

- Partner with the Real Estate Transactions team on acquisition, disposition, and other market-facing transaction execution.

- Work with Cisco Procurement and Legal to contract, onboard and manage the best external consultants, including land-use counsel, development planners, appraisers, real estate analysts, due diligence teams, and development advisors.

- Coordinate with WPR PMO, Design & Construction and WPR Energy, EH&S and Engineering Teams on design and master planning consultant selection, early technical feasibility, delivery assumptions, and handoff readiness.

- Support early-stage master planning, preliminary programming, conceptual design.

- Lead entitlement packages, regulatory agency approvals for development phasing plans.

- Guide planning and design efforts to preserve asset value on owned properties and large campuses, then hand off execution leadership to Design & Construction once entitlements are secured for large projects and is ready for delivery.

- Establish repeatable data and reporting on owned asset optimization, due diligence, stage-gate, and development entitlement planning practices for the global real estate organization.

- Maintain executive-ready materials, recommendations, assumptions, risks, options, and decision records for governance forums.

Leadership Scope

This role will lead a small, specialized strategy and development team and is accountable for building the operating model, decision frameworks, advisor network, and governance materials needed to support global owned-asset decisions.
The role will lead through both direct team leadership and enterprise influence, coordinating across Real Estate Strategy, Global Business Partners, Finance and Accounting, Real Estate Transactions, Legal, WPR PMO, Design & Construction, Operations, Government Affairs and external consultants.

Minimum Qualifications:

- 15+ years of experience in real estate development and disposition, portfolio strategy, land use, entitlements, acquisitions, asset strategy, corporate real estate, or related owner-side real estate leadership.

- Experience leading teams or complex cross-functional work streams in a matrixed environment.

- Deep experience evaluating owned real estate assets, highest and best use, development, feasibility, entitlement pathways, regulatory approvals, redevelopment potential, and disposition options.

- Experience with large-scale real estate portfolios and leading acquisition and disposition due diligence for complex land or property opportunities.

- Strong understanding of owned-versus-leased alternatives, capital investment tradeoffs, asset repositioning, portfolio optimization, and governance approvals.

- Experience leading external consultants, land-use counsel, planners, appraisers, development advisors, due diligence teams, and real estate analysts.

- Ability to prepare and defend executive-level recommendations for investment steering committees, portfolio governance bodies, and capital approval forums.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience in a global technology company, corporate real estate organization, developer, institutional owner, REIT, real estate investment firm, or large owner-operator environment.

- Experience with global portfolios and cross-border real estate strategy.

- Experience developing master plans, entitlement strategies, conceptual site plans, phasing strategies, and early project approval materials.

- Advanced degree or professional background in real estate, urban planning, architecture, engineering, business, finance, construction, or a related field.

- Develop strategic architectural narratives that translate complex, emerging technologies into tangible business outcomes for executive stakeholders.

Required Qualifications
- 10+ years of experience in business development, product management, or high-level technical/Sales consulting in the ICT industry.

- Native Japanese proficiency (N1 or higher) and business-level English proficiency (capable of global collaboration).

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in national-level projects or industry-wide standardization initiatives.
- Familiarity with research-to-business transitions (e.g., university/R&D center collaborations).
- Experience working with global product teams or engineering Business Entities.
- Background in advanced infrastructure domains (e.g., Liquid cooling, high-performance computing, or advanced cryptography).

部門: CTOオフィス
レポートライン: Japan CTO

ポジション概要
- シスコジャパンCTOオフィスにおいて、次世代技術のインキュベーションと市場形成を主導する優秀なビジネス開発マネージャー（BDM）を募集します。本職務では、シスコの広範なポートフォリオを統合し、複雑なビジネス課題を解決するための「包括的なアーキテクチャ戦略（Unified Architectural Strategy）」を定義する役割を担います。
- 本職務の重要な要素として、CTOオフィスのソリューションエンジニア（SE）と密接に連携し、主要ソリューションや製品の営業支援をリードしていただきます。SEと「バディ」を組み、顧客エンゲージメントにおいて技術的な卓越性と戦略的な整合性を担保する役割を担います。

主な業務内容
- 先進技術領域（量子技術、DCファシリティ（水冷・液浸、FMP等）、AI統合ソフトウェア等）のインキュベーションおよび市場投入戦略の策定。

jobs.description:
Meet the Team:

Customer Experience (CX) Customer Success Specialists (CSS) are a team of extraordinary technical guides whose #1 focus is to deliver exclusive customer experience. We help solve business challenges with network-centric solutions that accelerate customer and partner success and dedication. As a team we know that in engineering and customer success, you can only be successful together, so we emphasize a culture of helping each other, working together, winning together and having fun together.

As a CSS team we help customers adopt and expand Cisco solutions by showing impact on the customer’s business goals. Maintaining an end-to-end lens, as CSSs we partner closely with Customer Success Executives, Success Programs Managers, sales accounts teams, delivery teams, partners and others to affect adoption and renewals.

Your Impact:

- This role ensures the adoption of software and value realization that lead to successful renewals and business growth by leveraging AI-driven insights and a thorough understanding of customer environments and deployments to tailor adoption strategies.
- It proactively develops and orchestrates technical adoption planning (TAP) execution, creating and driving TAPs that align with customer goals to maximize technology investments and promote the full utilization of Cisco technologies, with designated Customer Success Specialists (CSS) typically owning TAP creation and pooled CSSs contributing architecture-specific expertise.
- The position facilitates alignment workshops to review adoption progress and drive expected customer outcomes and benefits, resulting in successful onboarding, adoption, and renewals.
- It drives scale impact by creating and delivering advanced technical enablement Expert Insight Series, stays current with the latest Cisco technologies including AI advancements, the competitive landscape, and industry trends to provide expert guidance, and participates in stakeholder workshops to articulate the state of the adoption business, including common barriers and market trends.
- The role is also involved in 1:1 customer engagements and community events, supporting Customer Experience Managers (CXMs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) in TAP and execution, while influencing executive and customer technical decision-making and fostering trusted advisory relationships. Additionally, the position collaborates with Customer Success Teams, Accounts, Sales, Partners, and others in GTM, leveraging AI and strategic insights to enhance customer adoption, address product concerns, and identify use cases that drive value and business outcomes.
- It acts as a technology evangelist between customers and Cisco's product teams, providing feedback to inform product development and enhancements, and leads collaboration with Product teams to address systemic product challenges identified by customers, driving usability and serviceability enhancements.

Responsibilities:

- Handles adoption for a moderately-sized portfolio of mid-sized customers, managing deployments that may span multiple products/solutions within a single technology area, using AI-powered analytics to monitor adoption and inform engagement strategies
- Drive adoption and expansion of Cisco Data Center Networking products (with main focus on Cisco ACI, Nexus Dashboard) by highlighting feature opportunities, winning use cases, and relevant strategies to customers
- Conducts standard or moderately customized technical enablement sessions across multiple products and audiences; organizes and runs moderately detailed demo setups for customer meetings, highlighting key features and ensuring follow-up for successful implementation
- Supports TAP execution by identifying adoption blockers, recommending relevant accelerators, and collaborating with CXMs to align activities with customer goals
- Maintains detailed customer profiles by gathering insights on their operations and goals, and applying AI-driven recommendations to suggest improvements in product use •Proactively follows up with customers post-session to ensure adoption progress, answer follow-up questions, and support successful CSAT outcomes
- Identifies common adoption blockers (e.g., lack of internal training, misconfigured features), recommends relevant accelerators, implements small enhancements in processes or products
- Collaborates with CXMs to align session delivery with customer goals and lifecycle milestones
- Applies product and service knowledge to guide onboarding and adoption conversations with customers
- Configures and maintains low to moderately complex test environments for customer demos, troubleshooting basic issues to support effective sessions
- Uses telemetry and AI-driven insights to identify opportunities for improvement
- Shares customer feedback and competitive observations to support product and service enhancements
- Mentors junior CSSs by reviewing their work, providing actionable feedback, and encouraging the use of AI to automate routine tasks
- Champions unified engagement by coordinating with other Cisco teams on shared customer activities
- Contributes to customer strategy by suggesting improvements, piloting new approaches
- Fosters cross-functional collaboration by connecting with support, sales, or engineering to resolve customer issues
- You possess practical technical proficiency with Data Centre technologies.
- You love customer interactions and understand customer needs and align architectural and vertical expertise to multi-functional teams
- You are able to explain technical concepts, give clients guidance and vision about the solution. You have a thorough understanding of the aligned technology/specialization areas, including features and use cases.
- You have industry recognized certifications and an ability to motivate change through innovation.

Minimum Qualifications:

- In-depth knowledge with the following technology and architecture areas: DC Networking, Cisco ACI, VXLAN, DC compute solutions such as Intersight, UCS, and understanding of DC automation and application development
- Ability to provide technical consultative support to Cisco customers, partners, account teams and other internal technical support teams.
- Ability to communicate, demonstrate, and accelerate the proper utilisation of Cisco ACI features as you encourage the customer to engage in the daily use of the solution.
- Deep technical knowledge with ability to understand and connect customer use cases/plans with Cisco solutions and how Cisco solutions can be optimally applied in a customer’s environment to accelerate business value.
- Ability to utilize moderate to complex lab environments to demonstrate the resolution of barriers across the entire customer lifecycle for Cisco Datacenter products & solutions.
- Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills that strengthen relationships with internal and external stakeholders up to the executive level.

Preferred Qualifications:

- BS/BA Engineering, B.Tech/ B.E/ M.Tech/ MCA in Computer Science or equivalent.
- 6+ years of experience in technical consulting or direct customer interfacing role with a deep understanding of industry best practices related to the datacenter domain.
- Cisco Certifications: CCNP / CCDP/ CCIE or equivalent strongly preferred.
- Extensive understanding of the technical fundamentals of aligned technology/specialization areas, including features and use cases, and an ability to define and articulate how technology can be used to solve business challenges.

Why Cisco?

Identifies short- and long-term sales opportunities and acts as an SME to drive demand generation, business development, and proposal development. Builds a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities, cultivates new customer relationships, identifies upsell opportunities, and partners with account teams to shape and close complex deals.

Develops technology-, solution-, and industry-based offerings and new consumption models that align customer needs with Cisco’s business objectives. Works closely with Field, Business Units, Product, Services, Marketing, and Partners to strengthen Cisco’s market position and expand wallet share.

This role has a strategic focus on the Automotive industry , with the objective of maximizing Cisco’s value proposition across the automotive value chain and vehicle lifecycle . Key domains include Connected Car, Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV), Smart City & Mobility, Manufacturing, and Connected Services , extending Cisco’s relevance beyond traditional enterprise IT.

jobs.title: Finance Analyst-Techno-Functional Financial Analyst – Finance, AI & Advanced Analytics - 6+yrs exp
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
Join a forward-looking Finance organization that combines financial analysis, business intelligence, automation, and emerging AI technologies to solve real business problems. The team partners closely with Finance, business stakeholders, Data Science, Engineering, Information Security, and Governance teams to develop secure, scalable, and practical analytical solutions.
Your Impact
As a Techno-Functional Financial Analyst , you will combine strong Finance and FP&A expertise with hands-on capabilities in Power BI, SQL, Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI .
You will translate complex finance requirements into dashboards, predictive models, AI-powered applications, and automated workflows that improve reporting, forecasting, productivity, controls, and decision-making.
This role requires practical experience in implementing AI/ML solutions for real business use—not just training, coursework, or proof-of-concept exercises.
You Will
Finance, Reporting & Business Analytics
- Prepare and deliver periodic financial and management reporting covering bookings, revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, forecasts, and other key business metrics.
- Partner with Finance Controllers, business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements and provide accurate, timely, and actionable financial insights.
- Perform variance analysis across actuals, forecast, budget, prior quarter, and prior year to identify drivers, trends, risks, and opportunities.
- Support monthly and quarterly close activities through data validation, reconciliations, P&L reviews, and investigation of reporting discrepancies .
- Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and executive reports using Power BI, Excel, and other BI tools .
- Extract, integrate, and analyze large datasets using SQL, Python, Excel Power Query , and appropriate data-processing technologies.
- Build forecasting, trend-analysis, and scenario-planning models to support management decisions.
- Translate functional requirements into reporting solutions, calculation logic, data models, dashboards, and analytical products.
- Perform data-quality checks and partner with Finance, Data Engineering, and Technology teams to resolve data and reporting issues.
- Automate recurring reports, reconciliations, and manual finance activities using Excel, VBA, Power Query, Python, Power BI , or workflow-automation technologies.
- Prepare executive summaries and presentations that clearly communicate business performance, financial risks, opportunities, and recommended actions .
- Document data sources, business rules, calculations, reporting methodologies, procedures, and key controls.
- Support user-acceptance testing, regression testing, implementation, and adoption of new finance systems, dashboards, and analytical solutions.
- Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve finance reporting and planning processes .

Generative AI, Machine Learning & Agentic AI
- Identify finance use cases where Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI can improve forecasting, reporting, productivity, controls, and decision-making.
- Design, build, test, and implement AI/ML solutions for real finance and business requirements .
- Develop predictive models for forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, risk identification , and other financial applications.
- Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance evaluation using appropriate ML techniques.
- Apply techniques such as regression, time-series forecasting, decision trees, Random Forest, XGBoost , or equivalent methods based on the business problem.
- Build Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs) for financial commentary, document analysis, summarization, question answering, and insight generation.
- Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using approved internal documents or structured data to produce grounded and traceable responses.
- Design Agentic AI workflows that retrieve data, perform analysis, apply business rules, and generate controlled outputs with human oversight.
- Integrate AI solutions with approved data sources, APIs, databases, dashboards, and workflow tools while following organizational security requirements.
- Apply prompt engineering, structured outputs, and contextual grounding to improve the accuracy and consistency of LLM-generated results.
- Implement AI guardrails covering data privacy, confidential information, prompt injection, hallucination, toxicity, and unsafe output .
- Establish human-in-the-loop review and approval controls for finance-related AI recommendations and outputs.
- Evaluate AI solutions using appropriate measures such as groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, accuracy, latency, and cost .
- Monitor implemented models for performance degradation, data drift, unexpected outputs, and changing business conditions .
- Explain model results and key drivers using interpretable techniques such as feature importance or SHAP , where appropriate.
- Maintain documentation covering model assumptions, training data, validation results, limitations, controls, and implementation decisions .
- Develop reusable and maintainable Python code using appropriate software-development and version-control practices .
- Use GitHub for source-code management, version control, documentation, issue tracking, and collaboration.
- Use GitHub Copilot for code development, debugging, test-case generation, refactoring, and documentation, while independently validating generated code.
- Partner with Finance, Data Science, Engineering, Information Security, and Governance teams to move suitable solutions from prototype to controlled business use .

AI/ML Implementation Experience
Candidates should be able to demonstrate one or more completed implementations, such as financial forecasting or predictive analytics, revenue/bookings/margin/pipeline/cash-flow prediction, financial anomaly detection, automated financial commentary, a finance knowledge assistant using RAG, document extraction or summarization, an AI agent that retrieves data and performs analysis, risk-scoring/classification models, or LLM-based workflows integrated with a database, API, or business application .
Candidates should be able to clearly explain the business problem, their individual contribution, data preparation and modeling approach, technology and architecture used, model selection and evaluation, security and governance controls, measurable business impact, and how the solution was deployed, monitored, and maintained .
Who You’ll Work With
You will collaborate closely with Finance Controllers, business leaders, Finance teams, Data Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, Information Security, Governance, and Technology teams to translate finance requirements into scalable analytical and AI solutions.
Who You Are
You are a techno-functional Finance professional who can connect finance requirements with technology solutions . You combine strong financial and commercial understanding with analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, curiosity about emerging technologies, and a strong ownership mindset.
You are comfortable explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, working across functions, and taking solutions from requirements through implementation and adoption . You also demonstrate sound judgment around financial-data confidentiality and the responsible use of AI.
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering , or a related discipline.
- Relevant professional experience in financial analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or finance transformation .
- Strong practical experience with Power BI, SQL, and Excel .
- Hands-on experience implementing Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions .
- Strong financial analysis, management reporting, and business-partnering experience.
- Advanced experience with Power BI, SQL, and Excel .
- Proficiency in Python for data analysis, Machine Learning, and AI solution development.
- Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or LLM-powered business applications .
- Experience using GitHub and GitHub Copilot for application or solution development.
- Demonstrated ability to translate finance requirements into dashboards, predictive models, AI applications, and automated workflows .
- Evidence of at least one AI/ML solution implemented or deployed for actual business use .

Technical Skills
Essential: Power BI including data modeling and DAX; SQL; advanced Excel and Power Query; Python; Pandas and NumPy; scikit-learn, XGBoost, or equivalent ML frameworks; Generative AI and LLM fundamentals; prompt engineering; structured LLM outputs; Agentic AI concepts and workflow orchestration; Git, GitHub, and GitHub Copilot; data visualization and executive-level financial storytelling.
Desirable: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable AI frameworks; RAG and vector databases; Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or equivalent cloud AI platforms; n8n, Langflow, Power Automate, or comparable workflow tools; REST APIs and JSON; model deployment, monitoring, testing, and MLOps; responsible AI, privacy, access controls, and enterprise AI governance; enterprise Finance systems and data platforms.
Preferred Qualifications
- Finance qualification or MBA in Finance .
- Relevant certifications in Power BI, Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, or cloud AI platforms .
- Experience applying AI/ML to finance use cases such as forecasting, anomaly detection, financial commentary, reporting automation, or decision support .
- Experience working in enterprise environments with strong data-security and governance requirements.

jobs.title: Inventory Accounting Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/11/2026 Members of the Finance organization at select locations will generally be expected to follow a hybrid work model, which includes two days of in-office attendance each week, with limited exceptions.

Meet the Team
The Inventory Accounting team manages US GAAP inventory accounting for Cisco Services and Supply Chain across more than 20 legal entities. We work at the intersection of Finance, IT, and Inventory Operations. We own the relationships with IT and Tax & Customs for inventory accounting systems and processes, and partner with downstream accounting teams that incorporate our inventory results into broader entity reporting.

Compliance and control are foundational to our work. We encourage thoughtful questions and practical improvements to how work gets done, but any change must preserve the compliance, accuracy, and controls our accounting processes and cross-functional partners depend on.

We support multiple inventory accounting models shaped by local tax laws, statutory requirements, and business needs. Depending on the entity, inventory may be expensed to Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) or capitalized, with tracking based on historical first-in, first-out (FIFO) costs or current value. Each model brings distinct accounting and reporting requirements, which can change as local requirements and global Cisco needs evolve.

Your Impact
We are looking for a curious, self-directed individual who understands that technology is a force multiplier when grounded in a strong understanding of accounting, data, processes, and controls. You will spend much of your time improving how work gets done, first within your assigned responsibilities and, over time, across the team. This includes analyzing current processes, identifying opportunities, building or coordinating practical improvements, and testing their impact.

This is also a hands-on accounting role. You will have assigned close and post-close responsibilities and use that work to assess whether earlier process and system changes delivered the intended results, then identify what needs attention next. Everyone on our small team contributes to routine operational work alongside broader improvement initiatives. Priorities can shift, so the role requires initiative, follow-through, sound judgment, and clear communication.

You will join an experienced team as a valued and respected contributor from day one. You will receive manager-led onboarding and guidance as you take ownership of your responsibilities, with opportunities to participate in mentorship programs available across Cisco and the business unit. Your observations and ideas matter regardless of tenure. The team values fresh perspectives, thoughtful questions, and insightful solutions. We expect everyone to listen respectfully, share their perspective, and help the team decide what to improve. We encourage and value passionate, well-reasoned advocacy for better ways of working. We also expect everyone to work constructively and collaboratively in support of the team’s final decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Systems, Process, and Continuous Improvement
·        Evaluate inventory accounting processes within Oracle C3, UiPath, and Excel, including the accounting rationale, data flows, and controls behind them.
·        Identify recurring manual work, process pain points, data issues, and opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.
·        Build or improve tools, reconciliations, reports, and workflow automations using advanced Excel and, where appropriate, scripting or Cisco-approved AI tools.
·        Apply AI and automation within company policies and established accounting controls, validating outputs before relying on them.
·        Translate accounting needs into clear requirements for IT and coordinate testing and implementation timing.
·        Review system changes after release, investigate unexpected results, and use subsequent close cycles to assess whether fixes and improvements worked as intended.
·        Document processes, entity-specific requirements, controls, and changes so the information is usable across the team.

Inventory Accounting and Close
·        Prepare and review subledger-to-general-ledger reconciliations, investigate variances, and document results for assigned entities or processes.
·        Prepare journal entries and perform assigned month-end and year-end close activities.
·        Review prior-period reconciliation results and coordinate with downstream partners responsible for related accounting items.
·        Monitor inventory accounting accuracy and investigate discrepancies with Operations, IT, and other accounting teams.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field.
- One to two years of experience  in finance or computer science
- Foundational understanding of accounting and finance, demonstrated through relevant education, work experience, or self-directed learning applied to a project or practical problem. Candidates without direct accounting experience should be prepared to demonstrate their understanding of core concepts such as journal entries, financial statements, and reconciliations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn complex processes and understand how data and accounting decisions flow through connected systems.
- Advanced Excel skills and a demonstrated interest in automation, scripting, data tools, or AI.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to ask thoughtful questions, explain findings, and coordinate work across teams.
- Initiative and follow-through, with sound judgment about when to act independently, seek input, or raise risks and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on experience with accounting analysis, reconciliations, journal entries, or financial close processes.
- Exposure to ERP systems, particularly Oracle, or workflow automation tools such as UiPath.
- Experience with scripting (such as Python), data visualization, or building tools to improve operational processes.
- Familiarity with inventory accounting or with how tax and statutory requirements affect accounting models and processes.
- Experience with generative AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, or other practical applications of AI in business processes.

Why Cisco?

jobs.description:

Join Splunk’s Tech Compliance team, where we lead security and compliance programs that are integral to the trust customers place in Splunk. We build consultative partnerships with product owners, engineering, and security teams to drive risk mitigation and controls management across commercial frameworks and cloud environments, while building more automated and scalable compliance operations.

Your Impact

As a Security Governance & Compliance Specialist, you will bridge security policy and engineering execution. You will lead and support commercial security compliance programs, strengthen audit readiness, and build automation that improves the quality, speed, and scalability of evidence collection and compliance operations.

You will partner closely with wide array of teams, including but not limited to; product, engineering, DevOps, and security, to translate sophisticated compliance directives into practical implementation guidance, integrate controls into engineering workflows, and help maintain a continuous compliance posture across Splunk’s cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

- Plan and execute security and technology audit from planning through to certification or report delivery, including auditor coordination, evidence collection, control mapping, remediation tracking, and stakeholder communication.

- Serve as main contact for internal and external auditors for assigned commercial compliance programs.

- Conduct gap assessments and audit readiness reviews for products, services, and new regulatory requirements; supervise remediation activities through closure.

- Translate compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance for engineering, product, and operational teams.

- Partner with DevOps and Engineering to incorporate compliance controls, validation, and evidence generation into CI/CD and operational workflows.

- Design, build, and run automated solutions for collecting, and validating audit evidence, as well as simplifying audit workstreams.

- Support continuous monitoring activities to maintain compliance posture between audit cycles.
- Help define, implement, and monitor controls for enterprise AI tools and AI/ML systems, including their secure use, configuration, and governance.
- Contribute to the ongoing evolution of scalable, AI centric, automation-forward compliance processes.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree plus 5+ years of experience in technical compliance, security, risk, audit, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
- Direct experience supporting or leading audit or certification programs from scoping through delivery, including control mapping, evidence collection, remediation, and auditor engagement; practical experience with commercial security and privacy frameworks, including SOC 1 & 2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and HIPAA.
- Experience building and implementing automation for evidence collection, compliance testing, control validation, or compliance reporting; solid understanding of security controls and governance in cloud-hosted environments, including AWS, GCP, and Azure.
- Engineering fluency, including experience with scripting or automation tools such as Python, Go, Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage auditors, engineers, and senior leaders effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ISO/IEC 42001, AI governance concepts, and emerging AI risk-management frameworks.

- Familiarity with CSA STAR, PCI DSS, and commercial privacy or customer-assurance programs.

- Experience integrating compliance controls and evidence generation into CI/CD pipelines or infrastructure-as-code workflows.

- Proven program-management skills, including coordinating multi-functional workstreams and delivering under evolving priorities.

- Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or cloud security certifications.

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst, Supply Chain Operations, Taiwan
jobs.description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Role Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Analyst to join our Supply Chain Operations team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our purchasing lifecycle, ensuring that our procurement processes are efficient, compliant, and accurate. You will act as a key partner to our Finance team and internal requesters, managing everything from Purchase Request (PR) issuance to invoice reconciliation. If you enjoy solving operational puzzles, possess an eagle eye for detail, and are eager to drive process improvements in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
- Procurement Lifecycle Management : Manage the end-to-end PR/PO process, ensuring requests are initiated within a 48-hour window. Verify charge codes, account types (Capex/NMA/Standard), and ensure alignment with departmental budgets.
- Financial Compliance & Accruals : Coordinate monthly financial accruals in our systems (e.g., FinABC). Ensure all POs are correctly categorized and that financial commitments are accurately reflected before period-end deadlines.
- Invoice Governance : Timely invoice approvals, ensuring strict matching between PO data, unit pricing, and quantity with input from requestors. Conduct thorough reviews to ensure payment is only made for services or goods successfully received.
- Discrepancy Resolution : Take ownership of identifying the root cause of invoicing issues. Work closely with Accounts Payable, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve discrepancies and prevent payment delays.
- PO Maintenance : Proactively monitor the health of open Purchase Orders, managing revisions, re-openings, and closures to ensure system data remains clean and actionable. Resolve aging PO issues
- Operational Support & Automation : Assist in managing automated reporting flows (e.g., Open PO reports) and look for opportunities to streamline manual tasks using existing system capabilities.

Required Skill Set
- System Proficiency : Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., Oracle Cloud CBM, or similar procurement platforms) is highly desirable.
- Analytical Rigor : Ability to deep-dive into data to identify inconsistencies. You must be comfortable working with trackers and spreadsheets to manage high-volume billing and project updates.
- Communication & Collaboration : Excellent interpersonal skills to navigate queries from various stakeholders—from technical requesters to external vendor contacts. You must be able to escalate issues effectively and provide clear, timely updates.
- Attention to Detail : A high degree of accuracy is non-negotiable. You will be expected to cross-reference multiple data points to ensure financial and process integrity.
- Resilience & Problem-Solving : Ability to navigate complex processes and "get to the root" of system or billing issues rather than providing temporary fixes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
- Operational Throughput : Consistency in meeting PR initiation and PO issuance cycle time.
- Financial Accuracy : Accuracy rate of monthly accrual entries and invoice matching to prevent overpayment or booking errors.
- Resolution Efficiency : Effectiveness in resolving invoice discrepancies and minimizing the number of outstanding or "aged" open POs.
- Process Compliance : Adherence to internal procurement policies and correct use of system GL accounts and line categories.
- Stakeholder Satisfaction : Timeliness and quality of support provided to internal requesters and Finance analysts regarding PO status and system queries.

Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
